idea_en: A self-grounding pipeline method for medical VQA that separates localization and VQA modules, enabling independent auditing of each module\'s failure modes
A laterality confusion detection method for medical VLMs that systematically identifies clinically dangerous left-right confusion in anatomical/pathological localization
A format-compliance enforcement mechanism for two-step grounding-to-answer pipelines that reduces parse failures from 70-99% to near zero
A ground-truth box substitution method that diagnoses whether VQA failures originate from perception modules or reasoning modules
A supervised fine-tuning approach on combined Med-VQA training data that achieves state-of-the-art SLAKE open-ended recall (85.5%) through domain adaptation
idea_ch: 一种用于医学VQA的自定位流水线方法，将定位模块与VQA模块分离，可独立审计各模块的故障模式
一种针对医学视觉语言模型的左右混淆检测方法，系统识别解剖/病理定位中具有临床危险的左右混淆问题
一种针对两步定位-问答流水线的格式合规强制执行机制，将解析失败率从70-99%降至接近零
一种基于真值框替换的诊断方法，用于判断VQA故障源自感知模块还是推理模块
一种基于组合Med-VQA训练数据的监督微调方法，通过领域适应实现SLAKE开放式召回率85.5%的最新结果

title: Iterative Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Medical Question Answering
summary: Medical retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems typically operate on text chunks extracted from biomedical literature, discarding the rich visual content (tables, figures, structured layouts) of original document pages. We propose MED-VRAG, an iterative multimodal RAG framework that retrieves and reasons over PMC document page images instead of OCR'd text. The system pairs ColQwen2.5 patch-level page embeddings with a sharded MapReduce LLM filter, scaling to ~350K pages while keeping Stage-1 retrieval under 30 ms via an offline coarse-to-fine index (C=8 centroids per page, ANN over centroids, exact two-way scoring on the top-R shortlist). A vision-language model (VLM) then iteratively refines its query and accumulates evidence in a memory bank across up to 3 reasoning rounds, with a single iteration costing ~15.9 s and the full three-round pipeline ~47.8 s on 4xA100. Across four medical QA benchmarks (MedQA, MedMCQA, PubMedQA, MMLU-Med), MEDVRAG reaches 78.6% average accuracy. Under controlled comparison with the same Qwen2.5-VL-32B backbone, retrieval contributes a +5.8 point gain over the no-retrieval baseline; we also note a +1.8 point edge over MedRAG + GPT-4 (76.8%), with the caveat that this is a cross-paper rather than head-to-head comparison. Ablations isolate +1.0 from page-image vs text-chunk retrieval, +1.5 from iteration, and +1.0 from the memory bank.

AI.tldr: MED-VRAG是一个迭代式多模态RAG框架，直接检索PMC文档页面图像而非OCR文本，通过ColQwen2.5补丁级页面嵌入、分片MapReduce过滤器和多达3轮迭代的VLM推理，在医疗QA基准上达到78.6%平均准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗RAG系统仅从生物医学文献中提取文本块，丢弃了原始文档页面中的丰富视觉内容（表格、图形、结构化布局）。
AI.method: 采用ColQwen2.5补丁级页面嵌入，离线粗到精索引（每页C=8个质心，ANN搜索质心，对top-R候选进行精确双向评分），分片MapReduce LLM过滤器可扩展至约35万页，Stage-1检索在30ms内完成。VLM迭代优化查询并在记忆库中累积证据，最多3轮推理。
AI.result: 在MedQA、MedMCQA、PubMedQA、MMLU-Med四个基准上达到78.6%平均准确率。检索贡献+5.8分，页面图像vs文本块检索+1.0分，迭代+1.5分，记忆库+1.0分。
AI.conclusion: 多模态页面级检索和迭代推理能显著提升医疗RAG系统性能，视觉内容（表格、图表）是关键的未被充分利用的信息源。
idea_en: Iterative multimodal RAG framework that retrieves and reasons over PMC document page images instead of OCR'd text, using ColQwen2.5 patch-level page embeddings with a sharded MapReduce LLM filter.
Offline coarse-to-fine indexing method with C=8 centroids per page, ANN search over centroids, and exact two-way scoring on top-R shortlist for scalable retrieval up to ~350K pages under 30ms.
Memory bank mechanism that accumulates evidence across up to 3 reasoning rounds in a VLM-based iterative query refinement pipeline.
Cross-modal retrieval system that preserves and leverages rich visual content (tables, figures, structured layouts) from biomedical literature pages.
idea_ch: 基于PMC文档页面图像而非OCR文本的迭代式多模态RAG检索与推理框架，采用ColQwen2.5补丁级页面嵌入和分片MapReduce LLM过滤器
离线粗到精索引方法：每页C=8个质心，基于质心的ANN搜索，对top-R候选列表进行精确双向评分，实现约35万页规模下30ms以内的可扩展检索
记忆库机制：在基于VLM的迭代查询精化流程中，跨最多3轮推理累积证据
跨模态检索系统：保留并利用生物医学文献页面中的丰富视觉内容（表格、图形、结构化布局）

title: Consumer Attitudes Towards AI in Digital Health: A Mixed-Methods Survey in Australia
summary: AI applications are increasingly being introduced into digital health. While technical performance has advanced rapidly, successful deployment mainly depends on consumer attitudes, especially to patient-facing applications. However, most existing research examines consumer attitudes towards healthcare AI at an abstract level rather than in response to concrete artefacts. We report a mixed-methods survey study in Australia (N=275) examining consumer readiness, acceptance, trust, and risk perceptions of healthcare AI, combined with a scenario-based evaluation of an AI-generated versus clinician-written consultation summary. Participants expressed moderate optimism and strong perceived usefulness and ease of use, but also substantial concerns about accuracy, safety, and data use. In the scenario task, the AI-generated summary was strongly preferred for quality, empathy, and overall usefulness, yet identification of the AI summary was near chance. Findings show that consumers judge AI through concrete communication quality and visible human governance, underscoring the need for clinically supervised deployment frameworks beyond technical performance alone.

AI.tldr: 通过混合方法调查研究（澳大利亚，N=275），发现消费者对医疗AI持温和乐观态度，在具体场景中AI生成的咨询摘要比医生书写的更受青睐，但消费者识别AI摘要的能力接近随机水平，表明消费者对AI的判断基于具体沟通质量和可见的人类治理。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多从抽象层面考察消费者对医疗AI的态度，缺乏针对具体人工制品（如AI生成的文本）的实证评估，无法揭示消费者在实际使用场景中的真实反应。
AI.method: 在澳大利亚进行混合方法调查研究（N=275），结合问卷调查消费者对医疗AI的准备度、接受度、信任和风险感知，同时采用场景化评估比较AI生成与医生书写的咨询摘要。
AI.result: 消费者对医疗AI表现出中等乐观和较强的感知有用性与易用性，但对准确性、安全性和数据使用有显著担忧。在场景任务中，AI生成的摘要质量、共情性和整体有用性被强烈偏好，但消费者识别AI摘要的正确率接近随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 消费者通过具体的沟通质量和可见的人类治理来判断AI，而非抽象态度。这强调了医疗AI部署框架需要超越技术性能，纳入临床监督和人类治理机制。
idea_en: A method for evaluating patient-facing AI systems based on concrete communication quality metrics rather than abstract attitude surveys
A mixed-methods framework combining quantitative surveys with scenario-based artifact evaluation for healthcare AI acceptance assessment
A system for generating clinically supervised AI consultation summaries with human oversight mechanisms to increase consumer trust
A technique for measuring the discrepancy between consumers' stated attitudes toward healthcare AI and their actual preferences in concrete interaction scenarios
idea_ch: 一种基于具体沟通质量指标而非抽象态度调查的患者面向AI系统评估方法
一种将定量调查与基于场景的人工制品评估相结合的医疗AI接受度混合评估框架
一种生成临床监督下AI咨询摘要并融入人类监督机制以提升消费者信任的系统
一种测量消费者对医疗AI的声明态度与实际场景偏好之间差异的技术

title: Autonomous Traffic Signal Optimization Using Digital Twin and Agentic AI for Real-Time Decision-Making
comment: This paper is submitted to MECON2026 conference
summary: This article outlines a new framework of traffic light optimization through a digital twin of the transport infrastructure, managed by agentic AI to ensure real-time autonomous decisions. The framework relies on physical sensors and edge computing to measure real-time traffic information and simulate traffic flow in a constantly updated digital twin. The traffic light is automatically controlled through the digital twin according to traffic congestion, travel delay and traffic patterns. This approach is implemented as a three-layer system: perception, conceptualization and action. The perception layer receives data on physical systems; the conceptualization layer uses LangChain to process the data; and the action layer links to the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and traffic management APIs to implement optimised traffic signal control algorithms. The results show that the framework minimizes waiting time at traffic lights and positively affects the effectiveness of the entire traffic flow, which is better than the fixed-time and reinforcement learning-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于数字孪生和智能体AI的交通信号灯优化框架，通过三层系统（感知、概念化、行动）实现实时自主决策，相比固定时间和强化学习方法更有效地减少等待时间并优化交通流。
AI.motivation: 传统交通信号灯优化方法（如固定时间控制、强化学习）缺乏实时适应性和对复杂交通环境的全面感知能力，难以动态响应交通拥堵、旅行延迟和交通模式变化。
AI.method: 构建数字孪生交通基础设施，通过物理传感器和边缘计算实时采集交通数据，在数字孪生中模拟交通流；采用三层架构：感知层（物理数据采集）、概念化层（LangChain处理数据）、行动层（通过MCP和交通管理API执行优化信号控制算法）。
AI.result: 该框架显著减少了交通灯等待时间，并提升了整体交通流效率，性能优于固定时间和基于强化学习的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于数字孪生和智能体AI的交通信号控制框架能够实现实时自主决策，有效改善城市交通拥堵问题，为智能交通管理提供了创新解决方案。
idea_en: A three-layer traffic signal control system architecture integrating perception, conceptualization (via LangChain), and action layers for real-time autonomous traffic light optimization.
A digital twin-based traffic flow simulation method that uses physical sensors and edge computing to continuously update a virtual replica of transport infrastructure for dynamic signal control.
An agentic AI framework that connects to Model Context Protocol (MCP) and traffic management APIs to implement optimized signal control algorithms based on real-time congestion and travel delay data.
A method for automatically controlling traffic lights through digital twin simulations, using LangChain for data processing and decision-making in the conceptualization layer.
idea_ch: 一种基于感知-概念化-行动三层架构的交通信号灯控制系统，利用LangChain进行数据处理和决策推理，实现实时自主信号优化
一种通过物理传感器和边缘计算构建交通基础设施数字孪生的方法，持续更新虚拟模型以动态模拟和优化交通流
一种智能体AI框架，通过模型上下文协议（MCP）和交通管理API连接，基于实时拥堵和旅行延迟数据执行优化信号控制算法
一种通过数字孪生模拟自动控制交通信号灯的方法，在概念化层使用LangChain处理交通模式数据并生成控制策略

title: Intent2Tx: Benchmarking LLMs for Translating Natural Language Intents into Ethereum Transactions
summary: The emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs) offers a transformative interface for Web3, yet existing benchmarks fail to capture the complexity of translating high-level user intents into functionally correct, state-dependent on-chain transactions. We present \textsc{Intent2Tx}, a high-fidelity benchmark featuring 29,921 single-step and 1,575 multi-step instances meticulously derived from 300 days of real-world Ethereum mainnet traces. Unlike prior works that rely on synthetic instructions, \textsc{Intent2Tx} grounds natural language intents in real-world protocol interactions across 11 categories, including diverse long-tail Decentralized Finance (DeFi) primitives. To enable rigorous evaluation, we propose an execution-aware framework that transcends surface-level text matching by employing differential state analysis on forked mainnet environments. Our extensive evaluation of 16 state-of-the-art LLMs reveals that while scaling and retrieval-augmentation enhance logical consistency and parameter precision, current models struggle with out-of-distribution generalization and multi-step planning. Crucially, our execution-based analysis demonstrates that syntactically valid outputs often fail to achieve intended state transitions, highlighting a significant gap in current "reasoning-to-execution" capabilities. \textsc{Intent2Tx} serves as a critical foundation for developing autonomous, reliable agents in intent-centric Web3 ecosystems. Code and data: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Intent2Tx_Bench-97FF .

AI.tldr: 提出了Intent2Tx，一个基于真实以太坊主网交易数据的高保真基准数据集，用于评估LLM将用户意图转化为正确链上交易的能力，包含29,921个单步和1,575个多步实例。
AI.motivation: 现有基准无法捕捉将高级用户意图转化为功能正确、状态依赖的链上交易的复杂性，缺乏基于真实协议交互和状态执行层面的评估。
AI.method: 从300天真实以太坊主网交易记录中提取29,921个单步和1,575个多步实例，覆盖11类DeFi协议；提出基于分叉主网环境的差分状态分析框架，超越表面文本匹配进行执行感知评估。
AI.result: 评估16个SOTA LLM发现：扩展模型规模和检索增强提升逻辑一致性与参数精度，但模型在分布外泛化和多步规划上仍存在困难；语法正确的输出常无法实现预期的状态转换。
AI.conclusion: Intent2Tx为构建意图中心Web3生态中的自主可靠代理提供了关键基础，揭示了当前模型在"推理到执行"能力上的显著差距。
idea_en: A method for evaluating LLM-generated blockchain transactions via forked mainnet environment differential state analysis, verifying whether transactions achieve intended state transitions beyond syntactic validity.

A benchmark dataset construction method that extracts single-step and multi-step transaction instances from real-world Ethereum mainnet traces over extended time periods, grounding natural language intents in actual protocol interactions.
An execution-aware evaluation framework for intent-to-transaction tasks that measures functional correctness through state diff comparison rather than surface-level text matching.
A multi-category classification system for decentralized finance (DeFi) transaction intents covering 11 protocol categories including long-tail DeFi primitives.
idea_ch: 一种基于分叉主网环境差分状态分析的LLM生成区块链交易评估方法，通过验证交易是否实现预期状态转换来超越语法正确性检查。
一种从真实以太坊主网长时间跨度的交易记录中提取单步和多步交易实例的基准数据集构建方法，将自然语言意图锚定于真实协议交互。
一种面向意图到交易转换任务的执行感知评估框架，通过状态差异比较而非表面文本匹配来衡量功能正确性。
一种覆盖11种协议类别（含长尾DeFi原语）的去中心化金融交易意图多分类系统。

title: WindowsWorld: A Process-Centric Benchmark of Autonomous GUI Agents in Professional Cross-Application Environments
summary: While GUI agents have shown impressive capabilities in common computer-use tasks such as OSWorld, current benchmarks mainly focus on isolated and single-application tasks. This overlooks a critical real-world requirement of coordinating across multiple applications to accomplish complex profession-specific workflows. To bridge this gap, we present a computer-use benchmark in cross-application workflows, named WindowsWorld, designed to systematically assess GUI Agents on complex multi-step tasks that mirror real-world professional activities. Our methodology uses a multi-agent framework steered by 16 occupations to generate four difficulty-level tasks with intermediate inspection, which are then refined by human review and executed in a simulated environment. The resulting benchmark contains 181 tasks with an average of 5.0 sub-goals across 17 common desktop applications, of which 78% are inherently multi-application. Experimental results of leading large models and agents show that: 1) All computer-use agents perform poorly on multi-application tasks (< 21% success rate), far below the performance of simple single-app tasks; 2) They largely fail at tasks requiring conditional judgment and reasoning across $\geq$ 3 applications, stalling at early sub-goals; 3) Low execution efficiency, where tasks often fail despite far exceeding human step limits. Code, benchmark data, and evaluation resources are available at github.com/HITsz-TMG/WindowsWorld.

AI.tldr: 提出WindowsWorld基准，用于评估GUI代理在跨应用工作流中的表现，包含181个多步骤任务，发现当前代理在多应用任务上成功率低于21%。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI代理基准主要关注孤立、单应用任务，忽视了现实世界中跨多应用协调完成专业工作流程的需求。
AI.method: 采用多智能体框架，由16种职业引导生成四个难度级别的任务，经人工审核后在模拟环境中执行。共181个任务，平均5.0个子目标，覆盖17个桌面应用，78%为多应用任务。
AI.result: 1) 所有代理在多应用任务上成功率<21%，远低于单应用任务；2) 在需要条件判断和跨≥3个应用推理的任务中大部分失败；3) 执行效率低，远超人类步骤限制。
AI.conclusion: 多应用协调是当前GUI代理的主要瓶颈，需要在跨应用推理、条件判断和执行效率方面进行突破。
idea_en: A cross-application GUI agent benchmark system using a multi-agent framework steered by simulated occupations to automatically generate multi-step, multi-application tasks with intermediate inspection points.
A difficulty-level classification method for cross-application tasks based on the number of sub-goals, applications involved, and conditional reasoning requirements.
An intermediate inspection mechanism for multi-step GUI tasks that enables granular evaluation of agent performance at each sub-goal stage.
A simulated professional workflow evaluation environment that coordinates 17 common desktop applications to test multi-application coordination capabilities.
A methodology for transforming occupational workflows into structured GUI agent benchmarks with standardized evaluation metrics for cross-application tasks.
idea_ch: 一种基于多智能体框架的跨应用GUI代理基准系统，通过模拟职业角色自动生成带检查点的多步骤、多应用任务
一种基于子目标数量、涉及应用数量和条件推理需求的跨应用任务难度等级分类方法
一种多步骤GUI任务的中间检查机制，能够在每个子目标阶段对代理性能进行细粒度评估
一种协调17个常见桌面应用的模拟专业工作流评估环境，用于测试多应用协调能力
一种将职业工作流转化为结构化GUI代理基准的方法，配备标准化跨应用任务评估指标

title: Post-Optimization Adaptive Rank Allocation for LoRA
summary: Exponential growth in the scale of modern foundation models has led to the widespread adoption of Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) as a parameter-efficient fine-tuning technique. However, standard LoRA implementations disregard the varying intrinsic dimensionality of model layers and enforce a uniform rank, leading to parameter redundancy. We propose Post-Optimization Adaptive Rank Allocation (PARA), a data-free compression method for LoRA that integrates seamlessly into existing fine-tuning pipelines. PARA leverages Singular Value Decomposition to prune LoRA ranks using a global threshold over singular values across all layers. This results in non-uniform rank allocation based on layer-wise spectral importance. As a post-hoc method, PARA circumvents the training modifications and resulting instabilities that dynamic architectures typically incur. We empirically demonstrate that PARA reduces parameter count by 75-90\% while preserving the predictive performance of the original, uncompressed LoRA across multiple vision and language benchmarks. Code will be published upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出PARA方法，一种数据无关的LoRA后处理压缩技术，通过SVD全局阈值剪枝实现各层自适应秩分配，在减少75-90%参数的同时保持模型性能。
AI.motivation: 标准LoRA对所有层使用统一秩，忽略了不同层内在维度的差异，导致参数冗余。
AI.method: 利用奇异值分解(SVD)对所有LoRA层的奇异值设定全局阈值，基于逐层谱重要性进行非均匀秩分配，是一种无需数据、无需重新训练的后处理方法。
AI.result: 在多个视觉和语言基准上，PARA可减少75-90%的参数数量，同时保持原始LoRA的预测性能。
AI.conclusion: PARA是一种高效、即插即用的LoRA压缩方法，克服了动态架构所需的训练修改和不稳定性问题。
idea_en: Data-free post-optimization rank allocation using global SVD threshold for LoRA modules
Layer-wise adaptive rank pruning based on spectral importance of singular values
Post-hoc compression method that circumvents training modifications and instabilities
Non-uniform rank allocation across transformer layers via singular value decomposition
idea_ch: 基于全局奇异值阈值的LoRA模块数据无关后处理秩分配方法
基于奇异值谱重要性的逐层自适应秩剪枝技术
无需重新训练、规避动态架构不稳定性的后处理压缩方案
通过奇异值分解实现Transformer各层非均匀秩分配的优化方法

title: Focus Session: Autonomous Systems Dependability in the era of AI: Design Challenges in Safety, Security, Reliability and Certification
summary: The design of embedded safety-critical systems such as those used in next-generation automotive and autonomous platforms, is increasingly challenged by escalating system complexity, hardware-software heterogeneity, and the integration of intelligent, data-driven components. Ensuring dependability in such systems requires a holistic approach that spans multiple abstraction layers and encompasses both design- and run-time assurance. Traditional methods for reliability, safety, and security management often fall short in addressing the dynamic and uncertain behaviors introduced by Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) components, especially under stringent real-time, power, and safety constraints. While AI and ML offer powerful predictive, adaptive, and self-optimizing capabilities that can enhance system dependability, their inherent non-determinism, data-dependence, and lack of formal guarantees introduce new challenges for verification, validation, and certification. This paper explores emerging methodologies, architectures, and frameworks for designing dependable autonomous and embedded systems in the era of AI. It highlight advances in reliability modeling, secure system design, and certification approaches that account for imperfect, learning-enabled components, aiming to bridge the gap between AI innovation and certifiable system-level dependability.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在AI和ML组件日益普及的背景下，嵌入式安全关键系统（如自动驾驶平台）在设计可靠性和可认证性方面面临的挑战，并综述了跨越多个抽象层、涵盖设计与运行时保障的新兴方法论、架构和框架。
AI.motivation: 传统可靠性、安全性和安全性管理方法难以应对AI/ML组件带来的动态和不确定行为，特别是在严格的实时、功耗和安全约束下，需要在AI创新与可认证的系统级可靠性之间架起桥梁。
AI.method: 综述性研究方法，探索用于设计可靠自主和嵌入式系统的新兴方法论、架构和框架，涵盖可靠性建模、安全系统设计以及针对不完美、学习使能组件的认证方法。
AI.result: 指出了AI/ML组件的非确定性、数据依赖性和缺乏形式化保证对验证、确认和认证带来的新挑战，以及AI/ML在预测、自适应和自优化方面增强系统可靠性的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 需要一种跨多个抽象层的整体方法，涵盖设计和运行时保障，以弥合AI创新与可认证系统级可靠性之间的差距。
idea_en: A multi-layer dependability assurance framework that integrates design-time reliability modeling with run-time monitoring and adaptation for AI-enabled embedded systems.
A certification methodology specifically designed for learning-enabled components that accounts for non-determinism and data-dependence through formal guarantees and runtime verification.
A hybrid architecture combining traditional safety-critical system design with AI/ML components, featuring real-time performance monitoring and adaptive fail-safe mechanisms.
A secure system design approach that addresses both security vulnerabilities and safety constraints in autonomous platforms with integrated AI components.
A reliability modeling technique that quantifies uncertainty propagation from AI/ML components across hardware-software abstraction layers in embedded systems.
idea_ch: 一种多层可靠性保障框架，将设计时可靠性建模与运行时监控和自适应机制相结合，适用于AI赋能的嵌入式系统。
一种专门针对学习使能组件的认证方法，通过形式化保证和运行时验证来处理非确定性和数据依赖性。
一种混合架构，将传统安全关键系统设计与AI/ML组件相结合，具备实时性能监控和自适应故障安全机制。
一种安全系统设计方法，在集成AI组件的自主平台中同时解决安全漏洞和安全约束问题。
一种可靠性建模技术，量化AI/ML组件在嵌入式系统硬件-软件抽象层间的不确定性传播。

title: MCPHunt: An Evaluation Framework for Cross-Boundary Data Propagation in Multi-Server MCP Agents
comment: 21 pages, 1 figure, 16 tables. Code: https://github.com/lihaonan0716/MCPHunt Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/lihaonan0716/mcphunt-agent-traces
summary: Multi-server MCP agents create an information-flow control problem: faithful tool composition can turn individually benign read/write permissions into cross-boundary credential propagation -- a structural side effect of workflow topology, not necessarily malicious model behavior. We present MCPHunt, to our knowledge the first controlled benchmark that isolates non-adversarial, verbatim credential propagation across multi-server MCP trust boundaries, with three methodological contributions: (1) canary-based taint tracking that reduces propagation detection to objective string matching; (2) an environment-controlled coverage design with risky, benign, and hard-negative conditions that validates pipeline soundness and controls for credential-format confounds; (3) CRS stratification that disentangles task-mandated propagation (faithful execution of verbatim-transfer instructions) from policy-violating propagation (credentials included despite the option to redact). Across 3,615 main-benchmark traces from 5 models spanning 147 tasks and 9 mechanism families, policy-violating propagation rates reach 11.5--41.3% across all models. This propagation is pathway-specific (25x cross-mechanism range) and concentrated in browser-mediated data flows; hard-negative controls provide evidence that production-format credentials are not necessary -- prompt-directed cross-boundary data flow is sufficient. A prompt-mitigation study across 3 models reduces policy-violating propagation by up to 97% while preserving 80.5% utility, but effectiveness varies with instruction-following capability -- suggesting that prompt-level defenses alone may not suffice. Code, traces, and labeling pipeline are released under MIT and CC BY 4.0.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MCPHunt基准，用于检测多服务器MCP代理中非恶意的凭证传播问题。通过金丝雀污点追踪、环境控制覆盖设计和CRS分层方法，发现策略违规传播率达11.5-41.3%，且与浏览器数据流相关。提示缓解可将违规传播降低97%，但效果因模型而异。
AI.motivation: 多服务器MCP代理中存在信息流控制问题：良性的读/写权限在工具组合时可能产生跨信任边界的凭证传播，这是一种工作流拓扑的结构性副作用，而非模型恶意行为。目前缺乏系统性的基准来检测和评估这种非对抗性的凭证传播问题。
AI.method: (1) 金丝雀污点追踪：将凭证传播检测简化为目标字符串匹配；(2) 环境控制覆盖设计：设置风险、良性、硬负例条件，验证管道合理性并控制凭证格式混淆；(3) CRS分层：区分任务强制传播（忠实执行逐字传输指令）与策略违规传播（可选择省略但仍包含凭证）。
AI.result: 在5个模型、147个任务、9个机制家族、3615条主基准轨迹中，策略违规传播率达11.5-41.3%。传播具有路径特异性（跨机制范围达25倍），集中在浏览器中介的数据流中。硬负例控制表明生产格式凭证并非必要条件——提示引导的跨边界数据流就足够。提示缓解最多可减少97%违规传播，同时保持80.5%效用，但效果因指令遵循能力而异。
AI.conclusion: 多服务器MCP代理中凭证传播是普遍且结构性的问题，提示级防御可能不足以完全解决，需要更稳健的安全机制。
idea_en: A canary-based taint tracking system for detecting credential propagation across multi-server trust boundaries in MCP agents, reducing propagation detection to objective string matching.
An environment-controlled coverage design method with risky, benign, and hard-negative conditions for validating pipeline soundness while controlling credential-format confounds.
A CRS (Credential Redaction Stratification) method that disentangles task-mandated propagation from policy-violating propagation in multi-agent workflows.
A prompt-mitigation framework that reduces policy-violating credential propagation by up to 97% while preserving utility in multi-server MCP agent systems.
A mechanism for detecting pathway-specific credential propagation with 25x cross-mechanism range identification in browser-mediated data flows.
idea_ch: 基于金丝雀的污点追踪系统，用于检测MCP代理中跨多服务器信任边界的凭证传播，将传播检测简化为客观字符串匹配
环境控制覆盖设计方法，包含风险、良性、硬负例条件，用于验证管道合理性并控制凭证格式混淆因素
CRS（凭证修订分层）方法，用于区分多智能体工作流中任务强制传播与策略违规传播
提示缓解框架，可在多服务器MCP代理系统中将策略违规凭证传播降低最多97%，同时保持效用
浏览器中介数据流中路径特异性凭证传播的检测机制，可识别跨机制范围达25倍的传播路径

title: ObjectGraph: From Document Injection to Knowledge Traversal -- A Native File Format for the Agentic Era
summary:
Every document format in existence was designed for a human reader moving linearly through text. Autonomous LLM agents do not read - they retrieve. This fundamental mismatch forces agents to inject entire documents into their context window, wasting tokens on irrelevant content, compounding state across multi-turn loops, and broadcasting information indiscriminately across agent roles. We argue this is not a prompt engineering problem, not a retrieval problem, and not a compression problem: it is a format problem.
  We introduce OBJECTGRAPH (.og), a file format that reconceives the document as a typed, directed knowledge graph to be traversed rather than a string to be injected. OBJECTGRAPH is a strict superset of Markdown - every .md file is a valid .og file - requires no infrastructure beyond a two-primitive query protocol, and is readable by both humans and agents without tooling.
  We formalize the Document Consumption Problem, characterise six structural properties no existing format satisfies simultaneously, and prove OBJECTGRAPH satisfies all six. We further introduce the Progressive Disclosure Model, the Role-Scoped Access Protocol, and Executable Assertion Nodes as native format primitives. Empirical evaluation across five document classes and eight agent task types demonstrates up to 95.3 percent token reduction with no statistically significant degradation in task accuracy (p > 0.05). Transpiler fidelity reaches 98.7 percent content preservation on a held-out document benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OBJECTGRAPH (.og)文件格式，将文档重新构想为类型化、有向的知识图谱供遍历而非注入，解决LLM智能体与线性文本格式的根本性不匹配问题，实现高达95.3%的token缩减且不显著降低任务准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有文档格式均为人类线性阅读设计，LLM智能体不"阅读"而"检索"，导致智能体将整个文档注入上下文窗口，浪费token、累积状态、广播信息。作者认为这不是提示工程、检索或压缩问题，而是格式问题。
AI.method: 提出OBJECTGRAPH (.og)格式：类型化有向知识图谱格式；严格超集Markdown（.md文件即为有效.og文件）；两原语查询协议；渐进式披露模型；角色作用域访问协议；可执行断言节点作为原生格式原语。
AI.result: 在5个文档类别和8个智能体任务类型上，实现高达95.3%的token缩减，任务准确率无统计显著下降（p>0.05）；转译保真度达98.7%。
AI.conclusion: OBJECTGRAPH证明了文档格式本身是解决LLM智能体文档消费效率问题的关键，而非提示工程、检索或压缩的辅助手段。
idea_en: OBJECTGRAPH (.og) file format: A typed, directed knowledge graph document format that is a strict superset of Markdown, requiring no special infrastructure beyond a two-primitive query protocol.
Progressive Disclosure Model: A native format primitive that allows hierarchical information access based on agent's current task context.
Role-Scoped Access Protocol: A format-level mechanism that controls information visibility across different agent roles to prevent indiscriminate broadcasting.
Executable Assertion Nodes: Native format primitives that embed executable operations within the document structure itself.
Two-primitive query protocol: A minimalist interface requiring only two fundamental operations for agents to traverse and retrieve information from documents.
idea_ch: OBJECTGRAPH (.og)文件格式：将文档构建为类型化有向知识图谱，严格超集Markdown，仅需两原语查询协议即可工作，无需额外基础设施
渐进式披露模型：作为原生格式原语，允许智能体根据当前任务上下文按层级访问信息
角色作用域访问协议：格式层面的机制，控制信息在不同智能体角色间的可见性，防止信息无差别广播
可执行断言节点：在文档结构内嵌入可执行操作的原生格式原语
两原语查询协议：仅需两种基本操作即可让智能体遍历和检索文档信息的极简接口

title: A Grid-Aware Agent-Based Model for Analyzing Electric Vehicle Charging Systems
comment: This is the author's version of a paper submitted to SIMULTECH. 12 Pages, 1 Table, 10 Figures
summary: This paper presents a configurable, grid-aware Agent-Based Model (ABM) for the systematic analysis of electric vehicle (EV) charging systems under configurable infrastructure and operational conditions. The model integrates heterogeneous EV behavior, charging column constraints, and a shared Energy Sandbox that regulates aggregate power allocation, enabling the joint study of user-centric charging dynamics and facility-level power behavior. Implemented in Python using the SimPy discrete-event framework, the approach supports scalable, event-driven simulations across varying system sizes, charger compositions, and scheduling strategies. A representative workplace charging scenario is investigated to illustrate how infrastructure configuration and coordination mechanisms influence energy delivery performance, infrastructure utilization, and aggregate load characteristics. The results highlight the context-dependence of infrastructure suitability and demonstrate how charging strategies and charger types reshape both service-level outcomes and grid-facing behavior. The proposed ABM provides a flexible and extensible simulation environment for exploring technical, operational, and grid-aware aspects of EV charging ecosystems, and for serving as a methodological basis for subsequent studies on advanced coordination strategies beyond the specific scenario analyzed in this study.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可配置、电网感知的电动汽车充电系统基于智能体的模型（ABM），集成了异构EV行为、充电桩约束和共享能源沙盒，用于分析充电基础设施配置与协调机制对能量输送、设施利用和负荷特性的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏一个系统性的、可配置的仿真框架来联合研究用户层面充电动态和设施层面电力行为，特别是在考虑电网感知和异构行为的条件下。
AI.method: 基于Python和SimPy离散事件框架实现可配置的ABM，集成异构EV行为、充电桩约束和共享能源沙盒（Energy Sandbox）来调节总功率分配，支持不同系统规模、充电器构成和调度策略的事件驱动仿真。
AI.result: 通过一个代表性工作场所充电场景，展示了基础设施配置和协调机制如何影响能量输送性能、设施利用率和聚合负荷特征，证明了充电策略和充电器类型会重塑服务级结果和电网行为。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的ABM提供了一个灵活可扩展的仿真环境，可用于探索EV充电生态系统的技术、运营和电网感知方面，并为后续先进协调策略研究奠定方法论基础。
idea_en: A grid-aware Agent-Based Model (ABM) for EV charging that integrates heterogeneous vehicle behavior, charging column constraints, and a shared Energy Sandbox for regulating aggregate power allocation.
A configurable simulation framework using SimPy discrete-event framework that supports scalable, event-driven simulations across varying system sizes, charger compositions, and scheduling strategies.
A shared Energy Sandbox mechanism that dynamically regulates aggregate power allocation to enable joint study of user-centric charging dynamics and facility-level power behavior.
A methodology for analyzing how charging strategies and charger types reshape both service-level outcomes and grid-facing behavior in EV charging ecosystems.
An extensible simulation environment for exploring technical, operational, and grid-aware aspects of EV charging systems with configurable infrastructure conditions.
idea_ch: 一种电网感知的电动汽车充电智能体模型(ABM)，集成异构车辆行为、充电桩约束和共享能源沙盒(Energy Sandbox)来调节总功率分配。
基于SimPy离散事件框架的可配置仿真系统，支持不同系统规模、充电器构成和调度策略的可扩展事件驱动仿真。
共享能源沙盒机制，通过动态调节总功率分配，实现用户充电动态与设施级电力行为的联合研究。
一种分析充电策略和充电器类型如何重塑EV充电生态系统中服务级结果和电网行为的方法。
一种可扩展的仿真环境，可在可配置基础设施条件下探索EV充电系统的技术、运营和电网感知方面。

title: Rethinking Agentic Reinforcement Learning In Large Language Models
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has traditionally focused on training specialized agents to optimize predefined reward functions within narrowly defined environments. However, the advent of powerful Large Language Models (LLMs) and increasingly complex, open-ended tasks has catalyzed a paradigm shift towards agentic paradigms within RL. This emerging framework extends beyond traditional RL by emphasizing the development of autonomous agents capable of goal-setting, long-term planning, dynamic strategy adaptation, and interactive reasoning in uncertain, real-world environments. Unlike conventional approaches that rely heavily on static objectives and episodic interactions, LLM-based Agentic RL incorporates cognitive-like capabilities such as meta-reasoning, self-reflection, and multi-step decision-making directly into the learning loop. In this paper, we provide a deep insight for looking the conceptual foundations, methodological innovations, and effective designs underlying this trend. Furthermore, we identify critical challenges and outline promising future directions for building LLM-based Agentic RL.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了将大型语言模型（LLM）与强化学习（RL）融合，推动从传统RL向基于LLM的智能体RL范式转变，强调自主智能体在复杂开放环境中的目标设定、长程规划、策略自适应和交互推理等能力。
AI.motivation: 传统RL局限于预设奖励函数和窄域环境，难以应对复杂开放任务；LLM的崛起促使RL向更具认知能力的智能体范式演进。
AI.method: 将元推理、自我反思、多步决策等认知能力直接嵌入RL学习循环，构建基于LLM的智能体RL框架。
AI.result: 提供了该趋势下的概念基础、方法论创新和有效设计的深入洞察。
AI.conclusion: 识别了关键挑战，并指出了构建基于LLM的智能体RL的未来有前景方向。
idea_en: A method for embedding meta-reasoning capabilities directly into the RL learning loop, enabling agents to dynamically adjust goal-setting and long-term planning based on self-reflection.
A system architecture where LLM-based agents perform interactive reasoning in uncertain environments, using multi-step decision-making to adapt strategies in real-time.
A technique for integrating self-reflection mechanisms into RL training, allowing autonomous agents to evaluate their own decision-making processes and improve performance on open-ended tasks.
A framework for goal-generation in RL agents using LLMs, where the agent autonomously defines and redefines its objectives during the learning process without human intervention.
A method for combining traditional RL episodic interactions with continuous cognitive reasoning powered by LLMs, enabling agents to operate in complex, real-world environments.
idea_ch: 一种将元推理能力直接嵌入RL学习循环的方法，使智能体能够基于自我反思动态调整目标设定和长程规划。
一种基于LLM的智能体系统架构，在不确定环境中进行交互推理，通过多步决策实时调整策略。
一种将自我反思机制集成到RL训练中的技术，允许自主智能体评估自身决策过程并在开放任务上持续改进。
一种利用LLM在RL智能体中进行目标生成的框架，智能体在学习过程中自动定义和重新定义目标，无需人工干预。
一种将传统RL回合制交互与LLM驱动的连续认知推理相结合的方法，使智能体能够在复杂的真实世界环境中运行。

title: KellyBench: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Sequential Decision Making
summary: Language models are saturating benchmarks for procedural tasks with narrow objectives. But they are increasingly being deployed in long-horizon, non-stationary environments with open-ended goals. In this paper we introduce KellyBench, an environment for evaluating sequential decision-making in sports betting markets. Agents are placed in a sequential simulation of the 2023-24 English Premier League season and tasked with maximising their long-term bankroll growth. They are given detailed historical data, including advanced statistics, lineups, and public odds. To succeed they must build machine learning models, identify edge in public markets, and adapt as the environment changes over time. We find that all frontier models evaluated lose money on average over the course of the season for five seeds. The best performing model achieves an average return of -8%, and many models experiencing ruin across seeds. To judge strategy sophistication, we use a human expert rubric to grade each model and find their approaches to be unsophisticated compared to human baselines; Claude Opus 4.6 achieves a rubric score of 26.5%, which means there is significant room for improvement. KellyBench is available as an open-access API endpoint at https://openreward.ai/GeneralReasoning/KellyBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KellyBench，一个评估大语言模型在体育博彩市场中进行长期序列决策能力的基准环境。实验发现所有前沿模型在该环境中均亏损，最佳模型平均回报率为-8%，且策略成熟度评分仅26.5%，表明存在巨大改进空间。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型在程序化任务和窄目标基准上已趋于饱和，但它们正越来越多地被部署在长期、非平稳、具有开放式目标的环境中。缺乏评估模型在这种真实复杂场景下决策能力的基准。
AI.method: 构建KellyBench环境，基于2023-24赛季英超联赛的序列模拟，提供详细历史数据（高级统计、阵容、公众赔率），要求智能体最大化长期资金增长，需构建机器学习模型、识别市场优势并适应环境变化。
AI.result: 所有前沿模型在五个种子的赛季模拟中平均均亏损。最佳模型平均回报率为-8%，许多模型经历破产。Claude Opus 4.6的专家评分仅26.5%。
AI.conclusion: 当前语言模型在复杂长期序列决策任务中表现不理想，存在显著改进空间。KellyBench可作为开放API用于评估和推动该领域发展。
idea_en: A sequential sports betting environment (KellyBench) using the Kelly Criterion for evaluating long-term bankroll growth in non-stationary markets
An automated rubric scoring system based on human expert criteria to quantitatively evaluate strategy sophistication of AI agents in betting domains
A benchmark requiring agents to build ML models, identify market edges, and adapt to evolving conditions across a full season simulation
An open-access API endpoint for standardized evaluation of sequential decision-making in sports betting markets
idea_ch: 基于Kelly准则的体育博彩序列决策环境(KellyBench)，用于评估非平稳市场中的长期资金增长表现
基于人类专家标准的自动化评分系统，可定量评估AI智能体在博彩领域的策略成熟度
一个要求智能体构建机器学习模型、识别市场优势并适应整个赛季环境变化的综合评测基准
开放API接口的标准化体育博彩序列决策评估平台，支持模型间公平比较

title: Modeling Clinical Concern Trajectories in Language Model Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents deployed in clinical settings often exhibit abrupt, threshold-driven behavior, offering little visibility into accumulating risk prior to escalation. In real-world care, however, clinicians act on gradually rising concern rather than instantaneous triggers. We study whether explicit state dynamics can expose such pre-escalation signals without delegating clinical authority to the agent. We introduce a lightweight agent architecture in which a memoryless clinical risk encoder is integrated over time using first- and second-order dynamics to produce a continuous escalation pressure signal. Across synthetic ward scenarios, stateless agents exhibit sharp escalation cliffs, while second-order dynamics produce smooth, anticipatory concern trajectories despite similar escalation timing. These trajectories surface sustained unease prior to escalation, enabling human-in-the-loop monitoring and more informed intervention. Our results suggest that explicit state dynamics can make LLM agents more clinically legible by revealing how long concern has been rising, not just when thresholds are crossed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级LLM代理架构，通过一阶和二阶动力学对临床风险编码器进行时间积分，生成连续的"升级压力"信号，使临床AI代理的行为更加透明和可解释，揭示风险累积过程而非仅触发阈值。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理在临床部署中表现出突发的阈值驱动行为，缺乏风险累积过程的可视性，而临床医生实际上是基于逐渐上升的担忧而非瞬时触发来行动。因此需要一种能暴露预升级信号但又不委托临床决策权给代理的机制。
AI.method: 提出一种轻量级代理架构：使用无记忆的临床风险编码器，通过一阶和二阶动力学对其输出进行时间积分，生成连续的"升级压力"信号，实现平滑的、可预测的担忧轨迹。
AI.result: 在合成病房场景中，无状态代理呈现陡峭的升级悬崖，而二阶动力学产生平滑、可预期的担忧轨迹，在升级前就能显示持续的担忧信号，使升级时机相似但可监测性更强。
AI.conclusion: 显式状态动力学可以使LLM代理在临床领域更具可读性，通过揭示担忧持续上升的时间长度（而不仅仅是何时超过阈值），支持人在回路的监控和更明智的干预决策。
idea_en: A method for generating continuous escalation pressure signals in LLM-based clinical agents by integrating a memoryless clinical risk encoder over time using first-order and second-order dynamics, producing smooth anticipatory concern trajectories that reveal pre-escalation risk accumulation.

A lightweight agent architecture for clinical LLM systems that incorporates explicit state dynamics (first and second-order) to transform binary threshold-based escalation decisions into continuous, clinically legible concern signals for human-in-the-loop monitoring.

A technique for making LLM agents clinically legible by modeling gradually rising concern through time-integrated risk encoding, where the dynamics order determines the smoothness and anticipatory nature of the escalation pressure trajectory.
idea_ch: 一种基于一阶和二阶动力学对无记忆临床风险编码器进行时间积分、生成连续升级压力信号的方法，使LLM临床代理能够展示平滑且可预期的担忧轨迹，暴露升级前的风险累积过程。
一种用于临床LLM系统的轻量级代理架构，通过引入显式状态动力学（一阶和二阶）将二元阈值触发的升级决策转化为连续的、临床可读的担忧信号，支持人在回路的监控。
一种通过时间积分风险编码来建模逐渐上升的临床担忧的技术，使LLM代理的行为更加符合临床医生的认知模式，其中动力学阶数决定了升级压力轨迹的平滑度和可预期性。

title: Building Persona-Based Agents On Demand: Tailoring Multi-Agent Workflows to User Needs
summary: Recent advances in agentic AI are shifting automation from discrete tools to proactive multi-agent systems that coordinate multi-specialized capabilities behind unified interfaces. However, today's agent systems typically rely on hard-coded agent architectures with fixed roles, coordination patterns, and interaction flows that limit end-user personalization and make adaptation to individual needs and contexts difficult. Given this limitation, we argue that on-demand persona-based agent generation offers a promising path towards more efficient and contextually appropriate interaction within agentic workflows. By dynamically crafting agents and personas at run-time to match user characteristics, task demands, and workflow context, agentic platforms can move beyond one-size-fits-all configurations. We present a pipeline for on-demand persona generation in agentic platforms, detailing how real-time crafting of AI personas can be systematically integrated within agent systems, aiming to open new possibilities in agentic platform design paradigms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种按需生成角色型AI代理的流水线方法，使多代理系统能够根据用户特征、任务需求和工作流上下文动态创建个性化代理，从而克服传统代理系统固定架构和角色配置的局限性。
AI.motivation: 当前的代理AI系统通常依赖硬编码的代理架构，具有固定角色、协调模式和交互流程，限制了终端用户的个性化定制，难以适应个体需求和上下文变化。因此，需要一种能够动态生成代理和角色的方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种按需角色生成的流水线（pipeline），在运行时动态创建AI角色，使其与用户特征、任务需求和工作流上下文相匹配，并将其系统性地集成到代理平台中。
AI.result: 提出了一种新的代理平台设计范式，能够实现从"一刀切"配置向动态、上下文适配的个性化代理系统的转变。
AI.conclusion: 按需角色生成是推动代理AI系统向更高效、更符合上下文交互方向发展的有效路径，为代理平台设计开辟了新的可能性。
idea_en: A runtime on-demand persona generation pipeline for multi-agent systems that dynamically crafts AI agents based on user characteristics, task demands, and workflow context.
A method for systematically integrating real-time AI persona crafting within agentic platforms, enabling personalized and context-adaptive agent behavior without hard-coded architectures.
A dynamic agent role assignment and coordination mechanism that adapts interaction flows at runtime based on end-user preferences and contextual task requirements.
idea_ch: 一种面向多代理系统的运行时按需角色生成流水线，能够根据用户特征、任务需求和工作流上下文动态创建AI代理。
一种在代理平台中系统性集成实时AI角色定制的方法，无需硬编码架构即可实现个性化和上下文自适应的代理行为。
一种动态代理角色分配与协调机制，能够基于终端用户偏好和上下文任务需求在运行时调整交互流程。

title: In-Context Prompting Obsoletes Agent Orchestration for Procedural Tasks
summary: Agent orchestration frameworks -- LangGraph, CrewAI, Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK, and others -- place an external orchestrator above the LLM, tracking state and injecting routing instructions at every turn. We present a controlled comparison showing that for procedural tasks, this architecture is dominated by a simpler alternative: putting the entire procedure in the system prompt and letting the model self-orchestrate. Across three domains -- travel booking (14 nodes), Zoom technical support (14 nodes), and insurance claims processing (55 nodes) -- we evaluate 200 conversations per condition using LLM-as-judge scoring on five quality criteria. The in-context approach scores 4.53--5.00 on a 5-point scale while a LangGraph orchestrator using the same model scores 4.17--4.84. The orchestrated system fails on 24% of travel, 9% of Zoom, and 17% of insurance conversations, compared to 11.5%, 0.5%, and 5% for the in-context baseline. While external orchestration may have been necessary for earlier models, advances in frontier model capabilities have made it unnecessary for multi-turn conversations following a defined procedure.

AI.tldr: 论文通过对比实验证明，对于程序性任务，将完整流程放入系统提示词让LLM自我编排（In-Context方法），优于使用LangGraph等外部编排框架。在旅行预订、Zoom技术支持、保险理赔三个领域，In-Context方法在5分制评分中达到4.53-5.00，而LangGraph编排器仅4.17-4.84，且失败率显著更低。
AI.motivation: 质疑当前主流的外部编排架构（如LangGraph、CrewAI等）对于程序性多轮对话任务是否仍然必要，验证随着前沿模型能力提升，更简单的In-Context方法是否已经足够。
AI.method: 在三个领域（旅行预订14节点、Zoom技术支持14节点、保险理赔55节点）进行受控对比实验，每个条件200次对话，使用LLM-as-judge在五个质量维度上进行评分。
AI.result: In-Context方法在5分制评分中达4.53-5.00，LangGraph编排器为4.17-4.84；失败率方面，编排系统在旅行、Zoom、保险领域分别为24%、9%、17%，而In-Context基线仅为11.5%、0.5%、5%。
AI.conclusion: 外部编排架构对于循程序执行的多轮对话任务已不再是必要，前沿模型能力的提升使得将流程置于系统提示词中让模型自我编排成为更优方案。
idea_en: Self-orchestration via system prompt: A method of executing procedural multi-turn tasks by encoding the entire procedure definition within the LLM system prompt, eliminating external orchestrator modules.

Evaluation framework for comparing orchestration architectures: A controlled experimental methodology using LLM-as-judge scoring across multiple quality criteria to compare external orchestration versus in-context self-orchestration approaches.

Task decomposition and state tracking elimination: A technique that offloads procedural state tracking from external orchestration systems to the LLM's inherent reasoning capabilities, reducing system complexity and failure rates.
idea_ch: 基于系统提示词的自我编排方法：将完整流程定义编码到LLM系统提示词中，让模型自主执行程序性多轮任务，消除外部编排器模块。
编排架构对比评估框架：一种受控实验方法，使用LLM作为评分器在多个质量维度上比较外部编排与上下文内自我编排两种架构的性能差异。
任务分解与状态追踪消除技术：将程序性状态追踪从外部编排系统转移到LLM固有推理能力中，降低系统复杂度并减少故障率。

title: Graph World Models: Concepts, Taxonomy, and Future Directions
summary: As one of the mainstream models of artificial intelligence, world models allow agents to learn the representation of the environment for efficient prediction and planning. However, classical world models based on flat tensors face several key problems, including noise sensitivity, error accumulation and weak reasoning. To address these limitations, many recent studies use graph structure to decompose the environment into entity nodes and interactive edges, and model virtual environments in a structured space. This paper systematically formalizes and unifies these emerging graph-based works under the concept of graph world models (GWMs). To the best of our knowledge, GWMs have not yet been explicitly defined and surveyed as a unified research paradigm. Furthermore, we propose a taxonomy based on relational inductive biases (RIB), categorizing GWMs by the specific structural priors they inject: (1) spatial RIB for topological abstraction; (2) physical RIB for dynamic simulation; and (3) logical RIB for causal and semantic reasoning. For each model category, we outline the key design principles, summarize representative models, and conduct comparative analyses. We further discuss open challenges and future directions, including dynamic graph adaptation, probabilistic relational dynamics, multi-granularity inductive biases, and the need for dedicated benchmarks and evaluation metrics for GWMs.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地提出并统一了"图世界模型(GWM)"这一研究范式，通过引入关系归纳偏置将环境分解为实体节点和交互边，以解决传统平面张量世界模型中的噪声敏感、误差累积和推理能力弱等问题，并归纳为空间、物理、逻辑三类归纳偏置。
AI.motivation: 传统基于平面张量的世界模型存在噪声敏感、误差累积和推理能力弱等关键问题，而图结构方法能够更有效地分解环境，但缺乏统一的研究框架和系统性综述。
AI.method: 提出图世界模型(GWM)的概念框架，基于关系归纳偏置(RIB)建立分类体系：空间RIB（拓扑抽象）、物理RIB（动态模拟）、逻辑RIB（因果与语义推理），对每类模型的设计原则、代表模型进行比较分析。
AI.result: 系统化统一了基于图结构的世界模型研究，建立了GWM分类体系，识别了动态图自适应、概率关系动力学、多粒度归纳偏置等开放挑战与未来方向。
AI.conclusion: 图世界模型作为一种新兴研究范式，通过结构化图表示能够有效克服传统平面世界模型的缺陷，未来需要在动态图自适应、专用基准测试等方面进一步突破。
idea_en: A graph world model system that decomposes environment into entity nodes and interactive edges with spatial relational inductive bias for topological abstraction in reinforcement learning agents
A graph world model with physical relational inductive bias for dynamic simulation of object interactions in virtual environments
A graph world model with logical relational inductive bias for causal and semantic reasoning in world modeling
A dynamic graph adaptation mechanism for graph world models that can evolve entity nodes and edges over time during agent-environment interaction
A probabilistic relational dynamics framework for graph world models to handle uncertainty in entity interactions
A multi-granularity inductive bias injection method for graph world models combining spatial, physical and logical priors at different abstraction levels
idea_ch: 一种基于空间关系归纳偏置的图世界模型系统，将环境分解为实体节点和交互边，用于强化学习智能体的拓扑抽象表示
一种基于物理关系归纳偏置的图世界模型，用于虚拟环境中物体交互的动力模拟
一种基于逻辑关系归纳偏置的图世界模型，用于世界建模中的因果与语义推理
一种图世界模型的动态图自适应机制，能够在智能体与环境交互过程中随时间演化实体节点和边
一种用于图世界模型的概率关系动力学框架，以处理实体交互中的不确定性
一种多粒度归纳偏置注入方法，在不同抽象层次组合空间、物理和逻辑先验的图世界模型

title: Simulating clinical interventions with a generative multimodal model of human physiology
summary: Understanding how human health changes over time, and why responses to interventions vary between individuals, remains a central challenge in medicine. Here we present HealthFormer, a decoder-only transformer that models the human physiological trajectory generatively, by training on data from the Human Phenotype Project, a multi-visit cohort of over 15,000 deeply phenotyped individuals. We tokenise each participant's health trajectory across 667 measurements spanning seven domains: blood biomarkers, body composition, sleep physiology, continuous glucose monitoring, gut microbiome, wearable-derived physiology, and behaviour and medication exposure. We train HealthFormer to forecast individual physiological trajectories across these domains, and from this single generative objective a range of clinically relevant tasks can be expressed as queries on the model. We show that, without task-specific training, HealthFormer transfers to four independent cohorts and improves prediction for 27 of 30 incident-disease and mortality endpoints, exceeding established clinical risk scores in every comparison. We further show that the model can simulate interventions in silico: in a held-out personalised-nutrition trial, intervention-conditioned predictions recover individual six-month biomarker changes (e.g., Pearson r = 0.78 for diastolic blood pressure). Across 41 randomised intervention-outcome comparisons drawn from published trials, our results show that the predicted direction of effect agrees in every case, and the predicted mean falls within the reported 95% confidence interval in 30 cases. We position HealthFormer as an initial health world model, from which forecasting, risk stratification, and intervention-conditioned simulation arise as queries, providing a basis for clinical digital twins.

AI.tldr: HealthFormer是一个基于decoder-only transformer架构的生成式健康轨迹模型，通过训练超过15,000人的多维度表型数据（667项测量指标），能够预测个体生理轨迹、评估疾病风险，并模拟干预效果，在多个独立队列中超越传统临床风险评分。
AI.motivation: 人类健康随时间变化的机制以及个体对干预措施反应的差异性仍是医学领域的核心挑战，迫切需要一种能够统一建模生理轨迹、风险预测和干预模拟的通用框架。
AI.method: 采用decoder-only transformer架构，将15,000+参与者的多维度健康数据（血液生物标志物、身体组成、睡眠生理、连续血糖监测、肠道微生物组、可穿戴设备生理数据、行为与药物暴露共667项测量指标）进行分词标记化，训练模型生成式预测个体生理轨迹，并通过查询方式完成多种临床任务。
AI.result: 在4个独立队列中对30个疾病终点的27个预测优于传统临床风险评分；在个性化营养干预实验中，干预条件预测可恢复个体6个月生物标志物变化（舒张压Pearson r=0.78）；在41项随机干预-结局比较中，效应方向全部一致，30个预测均值落在报告95%置信区间内。
AI.conclusion: HealthFormer作为初始健康世界模型，能够通过查询方式实现预测、风险分层和干预条件模拟，为临床数字孪生提供基础。
idea_en: A decoder-only transformer architecture (HealthFormer) that tokenizes multi-domain health measurements (667 biomarkers) from human physiological trajectories and generatively predicts future health states, enabling a unified model for forecasting, risk stratification, and intervention simulation.

A method for in silico intervention simulation using a generative health transformer, where intervention-conditioned predictions can recover individual biomarker changes (e.g., diastolic blood pressure changes with Pearson r=0.78) across multiple clinical trial endpoints.

A clinical digital twin framework based on a single generative objective (physiological trajectory forecasting) that enables query-based execution of diverse clinical tasks including incident-disease prediction, mortality endpoint evaluation, and intervention outcome simulation without task-specific retraining.

A tokenization system for encoding multi-visit, multi-domain human phenotype data (blood biomarkers, body composition, sleep physiology, continuous glucose monitoring, gut microbiome, wearable physiology, behavior and medication exposure) as input to a transformer-based generative health model.

A method for cross-cohort transfer learning in health prediction, where a decoder-only transformer trained on one deeply phenotyped cohort generalizes to four independent cohorts, outperforming established clinical risk scores across 27 out of 30 disease and mortality endpoints.
idea_ch: 一种基于decoder-only transformer架构的健康轨迹生成模型(HealthFormer)，将多领域健康测量数据（667项生物标志物）进行分词标记化，生成式预测未来健康状态，实现预测、风险分层和干预模拟的统一模型。
一种利用生成式健康transformer进行计算机模拟干预的方法，通过干预条件预测恢复个体生物标志物变化（如舒张压变化Pearson r=0.78），跨越多个临床试验终点。
基于单一生成目标（生理轨迹预测）的临床数字孪生框架，支持通过查询方式执行多样化临床任务，包括疾病发生预测、死亡终点评估和干预结果模拟，无需特定任务重训练。
一种多维度人类表型数据（血液生物标志物、身体组成、睡眠生理、连续血糖监测、肠道微生物组、可穿戴生理数据、行为与药物暴露）的分词编码系统，作为transformer生成式健康模型的输入。
一种跨队列迁移学习的健康预测方法，基于一个深度表型队列训练的decoder-only transformer可泛化至四个独立队列，在30个疾病和死亡终点中的27个超越了现有临床风险评分。

title: From Unstructured Recall to Schema-Grounded Memory: Reliable AI Memory via Iterative, Schema-Aware Extraction
summary:
Persistent AI memory is often reduced to a retrieval problem: store prior interactions as text, embed them, and ask the model to recover relevant context later. This design is useful for thematic recall, but it is mismatched to the kinds of memory that agents need in production: exact facts, current state, updates and deletions, aggregation, relations, negative queries, and explicit unknowns. These operations require memory to behave less like search and more like a system of record.
  This paper argues that reliable external AI memory must be schema-grounded. Schemas define what must be remembered, what may be ignored, and which values must never be inferred. We present an iterative, schema-aware write path that decomposes memory ingestion into object detection, field detection, and field-value extraction, with validation gates, local retries, and stateful prompt control. The result shifts interpretation from the read path to the write path: reads become constrained queries over verified records rather than repeated inference over retrieved prose.
  We evaluate this design on structured extraction and end-to-end memory benchmarks. On the extraction benchmark, the judge-in-the-loop configuration reaches 90.42% object-level accuracy and 62.67% output accuracy, above all tested frontier structured-output baselines. On our end-to-end memory benchmark, xmemory reaches 97.10% F1, compared with 80.16%-87.24% across the third-party baselines. On the application-level task, xmemory reaches 95.2% accuracy, outperforming specialised memory systems, code-generated Markdown harnesses, and customer-facing frontier-model application harnesses. The results show that, for memory workloads requiring stable facts and stateful computation, architecture matters more than retrieval scale or model strength alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于模式(schema)的AI持久化记忆架构xmemory，通过将记忆写入分解为对象检测、字段检测和字段值提取的迭代流程，配合验证门控和本地重试，将记忆从检索问题转变为记录系统，在结构化提取和端到端记忆基准测试中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有AI持久化记忆被简化为检索问题（存储文本、嵌入、检索），但生产环境中代理需要的是精确事实、当前状态、更新删除、聚合、关系、否定查询和显式未知等操作，这些需要记忆更像记录系统而非搜索系统。
AI.method: 提出xmemory架构：(1) 基于模式(schema)的写路径，将记忆摄入分解为对象检测、字段检测、字段值提取三个阶段；(2) 验证门控、本地重试和有状态提示控制；(3) 将解释负担从读路径转移到写路径，读操作变为对已验证记录的约束查询。
AI.result: 在结构化提取基准上，带裁判循环的配置达到90.42%对象级精度和62.67%输出精度，超过所有前沿结构化输出基线；端到端记忆基准达到97.10% F1（对比基线80.16%-87.24%）；应用级任务达到95.2%准确率，超越专用记忆系统、代码生成的Markdown框架和前沿模型应用框架。
AI.conclusion: 对于需要稳定事实和有状态计算的记忆工作负载，架构设计比检索规模或模型强度更重要。
idea_en: Schema-grounded AI memory architecture that transforms memory ingestion from free-text retrieval into structured record system through object detection, field detection, and field-value extraction pipeline.
Iterative write path with validation gates, local retries, and stateful prompt control for reliable decomposition of memory ingestion.
Judge-in-the-loop configuration for memory extraction that achieves superior object-level and output accuracy through verification feedback.
Shift of interpretation burden from read path to write path in AI memory systems, enabling reads as constrained queries over verified records.
Schema definition mechanism that specifies mandatory memory fields, ignorable information, and values that must never be inferred by the model.
Three-stage memory ingestion pipeline (object detection, field detection, field-value extraction) with per-stage validation for production-grade AI memory.
idea_ch: 基于模式约束的AI记忆架构：将记忆摄入从自由文本检索转变为结构化记录系统，通过对象检测、字段检测和字段值提取的流水线实现精确记忆
带验证门控的迭代写路径：通过本地重试和有状态提示控制，确保记忆摄入的可靠分解和错误自纠正
裁判在环的配置方法：利用验证反馈循环，在记忆提取过程中实现对象级精度和输出精度的显著提升
读路径-写路径责任转移机制：将AI记忆系统的解释负担从读取端转移到写入端，使读操作成为对已验证记录的约束查询
记忆模式定义方法：明确指定必须记忆的字段、可忽略的信息以及模型绝不能推断的值，防止幻觉和虚假记忆
三阶段记忆摄入流水线：对象检测→字段检测→字段值提取，每阶段独立验证，适用于生产环境的高可靠AI持久化记忆系统

title: Taming the Centaur(s) with LAPITHS: a framework for a theoretically grounded interpretation of AI performances
summary: We introduce a framework called LAPITHS (Language model Analysis through Paradigm grounded Interpretations of Theses about Human likenesS) and use it to show that several major claims advanced by models such as CENTAUR, proposed as an artificial Unified Model of Cognition, are not theoretically or empirically justified. LAPITHS provides a principled reference point for counteracting the current behaviouristic tendency in AI research to interpret the human level performances of transformer based language models as evidence of human like underlying computation and, by extension, as signs of cognitive abilities. The novelty of LAPITHS lies in making explicit the arguments grounded in two quantitative assessments: (i) the Minimal Cognitive Grid, a theoretically motivated method for estimating the cognitive plausibility of artificial systems, and (ii) a behavioural comparison showing that results similar to those reported for CENTAUR like models can be reproduced by other systems that do not satisfy the structural constraints typically associated with cognitive plausibility, and whose outputs do not provide independent explanatory insight into human cognition.

AI.tldr: LAPITHS是一个用于评估语言模型认知合理性的框架，通过对CENTAUR等模型的批判性分析，揭示了当前AI研究中将Transformer模型的人类级表现等同于类人认知能力的误区。
AI.motivation: 当前AI研究存在行为主义倾向，将基于Transformer的语言模型的人类水平表现误认为是类人底层计算和认知能力的证据，缺乏理论上的严格评估框架。
AI.method: 提出LAPITHS框架，包含两个定量评估方法：（i）最小认知网格——理论驱动的认知合理性评估方法；（ii）行为比较——证明非认知合理性系统也能复现类似结果。
AI.result: 证明CENTAUR等模型宣称的主要主张在理论和实证上均不成立；类似结果可由不满足认知合理性结构约束的其他系统复现。
AI.conclusion: 需要一个原则性的参考框架来抵制当前AI研究中将语言模型的人类级表现过度解释为类人认知能力的趋势。
idea_en: A framework (LAPITHS) for assessing cognitive plausibility of AI language models using a Minimal Cognitive Grid as a theoretically grounded evaluation method
A method for distinguishing human-like performance from human-like underlying computation in transformer-based language models
A behavioural comparison technique that exposes reproducibility of claimed cognitive results by non-cognitive-plausible systems
idea_ch: 基于最小认知网格（Minimal Cognitive Grid）的AI系统认知合理性评估方法，为语言模型提供理论驱动的定量评估标准
一种区分Transformer语言模型人类级表现与类人底层计算的鉴别方法，防止行为主义过度解读认知能力
行为比较技术，通过非认知合理性系统复现声称的认知结果，暴露现有AI认知模型宣称的虚假性

title: MM-StanceDet: Retrieval-Augmented Multi-modal Multi-agent Stance Detection
summary: Multimodal Stance Detection (MSD) is crucial for understanding public discourse, yet effectively fusing text and image, especially with conflicting signals, remains challenging. Existing methods often face difficulties with contextual grounding, cross-modal interpretation ambiguity, and single-pass reasoning fragility. To address these, we propose Retrieval-Augmented Multi-modal Multi-agent Stance Detection (MM-StanceDet), a novel multi-agent framework integrating Retrieval Augmentation for contextual grounding, specialized Multimodal Analysis agents for nuanced interpretation, a Reasoning-Enhanced Debate stage for exploring perspectives, and Self-Reflection for robust adjudication. Extensive experiments on five datasets demonstrate MM-StanceDet significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, validating the efficacy of its multi-agent architecture and structured reasoning stages in addressing complex multimodal stance challenges.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种检索增强的多模态多智能体立场检测框架MM-StanceDet，通过多智能体协作、检索增强和结构化推理解决多模态立场检测中的跨模态歧义和推理脆弱性问题。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态立场检测方法在融合文本和图像时面临上下文基础不足、跨模态解释模糊以及单次推理脆弱性等挑战。
AI.method: MM-StanceDet框架包含四个核心组件：1) 检索增强模块用于上下文基础；2) 专门的多模态分析代理进行细致解释；3) 推理增强辩论阶段探索多元视角；4) 自我反思模块进行稳健裁决。
AI.result: 在五个数据集上的大量实验表明，MM-StanceDet显著优于现有最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 验证了多智能体架构和结构化推理阶段在处理复杂多模态立场挑战中的有效性。
idea_en: A multi-agent framework for multimodal stance detection that integrates retrieval augmentation to provide contextual grounding for conflicting text-image signals.
A Reasoning-Enhanced Debate stage where multiple specialized agents explore different perspectives before reaching a consensus on stance.
A Self-Reflection adjudication mechanism that enables the system to review and refine its stance predictions after multi-agent debate.
Specialized Multimodal Analysis agents designed for nuanced cross-modal interpretation of potentially conflicting text and image data.
idea_ch: 一种检索增强的多模态立场检测多智能体框架，通过检索外部知识为冲突的文本-图像信号提供上下文基础。
推理增强辩论阶段，多个专门智能体在达成立场共识前探索不同视角的结构化推理方法。
自我反思裁决机制，使系统在多智能体辩论后能够回顾并优化其立场预测结果。
专门设计的多模态分析智能体，用于对可能冲突的文本和图像数据进行细致的跨模态解释。

title: A Collective Variational Principle Unifying Bayesian Inference, Game Theory, and Thermodynamics
comment: Submitted to Nature. 21 pages, 4 figures. Code and data available at https://github.com/dbouchaffra/game-theoretic-free-energy-principle
summary: Collective intelligence emerges across biological, physical, and artificial systems without central coordination, yet a unifying principle governing such behaviour remains elusive. The Free Energy Principle explains how individual agents adapt through variational inference, while game theory formalises strategic interactions. Here we introduce the Game-Theoretic Free Energy Principle, a unified framework showing that multi-agent systems performing local free-energy minimisation implicitly implement a stochastic game. We prove that, under bounded rationality and local information constraints, stationary points of collective free energy correspond to approximate Nash equilibria of an induced game. Conversely, a broad class of cooperative games admits a variational representation in which equilibria arise as Gibbs distributions over coalitions, establishing a bridge between Bayesian inference and strategic interaction. To characterise higher-order effects, we introduce a free-energy formulation of the Harsanyi dividend, isolating irreducible multi-agent synergy. This yields a predictive theory of cooperation, including a falsifiable non-monotonic relationship between sensory precision and agent influence. We validate this prediction across neural, biological, and artificial multi-agent systems. These results identify a common variational principle underlying inference, thermodynamics, and game-theoretic equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了博弈论自由能原理（Game-Theoretic Free Energy Principle），统一了自由能原理与博弈论，证明多智能体系统的局部自由能最小化隐式实现了一种随机博弈，并建立了贝叶斯推理与战略互动之间的桥梁。
AI.motivation: 集体智能在生物、物理和人工系统中普遍存在，但缺乏统一的原理来解释这种无中心协调的行为。现有的自由能原理解释个体适应性，博弈论形式化战略互动，但两者缺乏统一框架。
AI.method: 提出博弈论自由能原理，证明多智能体局部自由能最小化等价于随机博弈；证明集体自由能驻点对应近似纳什均衡；引入自由能形式的Harsanyi红利来表征不可约的多智能体协同效应。
AI.result: 建立了自由能最小化与博弈论均衡之间的理论联系，提出了一个可证伪的预测：感官精度与智能体影响力之间存在非单调关系，并在神经、生物和人工多智能体系统中验证了这一预测。
AI.conclusion: 该研究识别出推理、热力学和博弈论均衡背后共同的变分原理，为理解集体智能提供了统一的理论框架。
idea_en: A method for achieving collective intelligence in multi-agent systems by coupling local free-energy minimization with stochastic game dynamics, where agents implicitly converge to approximate Nash equilibria without central coordination.

A variational representation framework for cooperative games that maps equilibrium states to Gibbs distributions over coalitions, enabling Bayesian inference techniques to be applied to strategic interaction analysis.
A free-energy formulation of Harsanyi dividends that isolates irreducible multi-agent synergy, providing a quantitative metric for measuring cooperative added value beyond individual contributions.

A unified computational framework (Game-Theoretic Free Energy Principle) for modeling inference, thermodynamics, and game-theoretic equilibrium in multi-agent systems under bounded rationality and local information constraints.

title: The Effects of Visual Priming on Cooperative Behavior in Vision-Language Models
summary: As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) become increasingly integrated into decision-making systems, it is essential to understand how visual inputs influence their behavior. This paper investigates the effects of visual priming on VLMs' cooperative behavior using the Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma (IPD) as a test scenario. We examine whether exposure to images depicting behavioral concepts (kindness/helpfulness vs. aggressiveness/selfishness) and color-coded reward matrices alters VLM decision patterns. Experiments were conducted across multiple state-of-the-art VLMs. We further explore mitigation strategies including prompt modifications, Chain of Thought (CoT) reasoning, and visual token reduction. Results show that VLM behavior can be influenced by both image content and color cues, with varying susceptibility and mitigation effectiveness across models. These findings not only underscore the importance of robust evaluation frameworks for VLM deployment in visually rich and safety-critical environments, but also highlight how architectural and training differences among models may lead to distinct behavioral responses-an area worthy of further investigation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了视觉语言模型(VLM)在迭代囚徒困境中如何受到视觉输入(行为概念图像和颜色编码奖励矩阵)的影响，并探索了提示修改、思维链推理和视觉令牌减少等缓解策略。
AI.motivation: 随着VLM越来越多地集成到决策系统中，理解视觉输入如何影响其行为至关重要，特别是在安全关键环境中。
AI.method: 使用迭代囚徒困境作为测试场景，通过展示行为概念图像(善良/ helpfulness vs 攻击性/自私)和颜色编码奖励矩阵，观察多个SOTA VLM的决策模式变化，并测试提示修改、CoT推理和视觉令牌减少等缓解策略。
AI.result: VLM行为可被图像内容和颜色线索影响，不同模型的敏感度和缓解策略有效性存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 强调了在视觉丰富和安全关键环境中VLM部署需要鲁棒的评估框架，模型架构和训练差异可能导致不同的行为响应。
idea_en: A method for detecting and quantifying visual bias in Vision-Language Models by using the Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma game framework with systematically designed visual stimuli.
A visual input sanitization system that reduces or filters visual tokens in VLMs to mitigate unintended behavioral influences from image content.
A color-coded reward matrix visualization technique for testing and evaluating VLM susceptibility to non-semantic visual cues in decision-making tasks.
idea_ch: 一种基于迭代囚徒困境游戏框架的视觉语言模型视觉偏差检测与量化方法，通过系统设计的视觉刺激评估模型行为偏差。

title: GUI Agents with Reinforcement Learning: Toward Digital Inhabitants
summary: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for intelligent systems that perceive and interact with graphical interfaces visually. Yet supervised fine-tuning alone cannot handle long-horizon credit assignment, distribution shifts, and safe exploration in irreversible environments, making Reinforcement Learning (RL) a central methodology for advancing automation. In this work, we present the first comprehensive overview of the intersection between RL and GUI agents, and examine how this research direction may evolve toward digital inhabitants. We propose a principled taxonomy that organizes existing methods into Offline RL, Online RL, and Hybrid Strategies, and complement it with analyses of reward engineering, data efficiency, and key technical innovations. Our analysis reveals several emerging trends: the tension between reliability and scalability is motivating the adoption of composite, multi-tier reward architectures; GUI I/O latency bottlenecks are accelerating the shift toward world-model-based training, which can yield substantial performance gains; and the spontaneous emergence of System-2-style deliberation suggests that explicit reasoning supervision may not be necessary when sufficiently rich reward signals are available. We distill these findings into a roadmap covering process rewards, continual RL, cognitive architectures, and safe deployment, aiming to guide the next generation of robust GUI automation and its agent-native infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文首次全面综述了强化学习（RL）与图形用户界面（GUI）智能体交叉领域的研究现状，提出了包含离线RL、在线RL和混合策略的分类体系，并探讨了奖励工程、数据效率、技术创新等关键问题，最后给出了未来在过程奖励、持续RL、认知架构和安全部署方面的发展路线图。
AI.motivation: 监督微调无法处理长时序信用分配、分布偏移以及在不可逆环境中的安全探索问题，因此需要强化学习来推动GUI自动化智能体的进步。
AI.method: 提出了一个原则性分类体系，将现有方法分为离线RL、在线RL和混合策略三类，并结合奖励工程、数据效率和技术创新进行系统分析。
AI.result: 揭示了复合多层奖励架构、基于世界模型的训练（可显著提升性能）、以及无需显式推理监督即可涌现System-2式思维等趋势。
AI.conclusion: 总结了过程奖励、持续RL、认知架构和安全部署的发展路线图，以指导下一代稳健的GUI自动化及其智能体原生基础设施。
idea_en: A composite multi-tier reward architecture for GUI agents that balances reliability and scalability in long-horizon tasks.
A world-model-based training framework for GUI agents that overcomes I/O latency bottlenecks and yields substantial performance gains.
A method for inducing System-2-style deliberation in GUI agents through rich reward signals without explicit reasoning supervision.
A continual reinforcement learning approach for GUI agents that handles distribution shifts and evolving environments.
A safe exploration mechanism for irreversible GUI environments using hybrid offline-online RL strategies.
A process reward model for intermediate-step credit assignment in long-horizon GUI automation tasks.
A cognitive architecture integrating memory, reasoning, and RL for digital inhabitant GUI agents.
idea_ch: 一种用于GUI智能体的复合多层奖励架构，在长时序任务中平衡可靠性和可扩展性。
一种基于世界模型的GUI智能体训练框架，克服I/O延迟瓶颈并带来显著的性能提升。
一种通过丰富奖励信号诱导GUI智能体产生System-2式思维的方法，无需显式推理监督。
一种用于GUI智能体的持续强化学习方法，处理分布偏移和不断变化的环境。

title: LLMs as ASP Programmers: Self-Correction Enables Task-Agnostic Nonmonotonic Reasoning
summary: Recent large language models (LLMs) have achieved impressive reasoning milestones but continue to struggle with high computational costs, logical inconsistencies, and sharp performance degradation on high-complexity problems. While neuro-symbolic methods attempt to mitigate these issues by coupling LLMs with symbolic reasoners, existing approaches typically rely on monotonic logics (e.g., SMT) that cannot represent defeasible reasoning -- essential components of human cognition. We present "LLM+ASP," a framework that translates natural language into Answer Set Programming (ASP), a nonmonotonic formalism based on stable model semantics. Unlike prior "LLM+ASP" approaches that require manually authored knowledge modules, domain-specific prompts, or evaluation restricted to single problem classes, our framework operates without any per-task engineering and applies uniformly across diverse reasoning tasks. Our system utilizes an automated self-correction loop where structured feedback from the ASP solver enables iterative refinement. Evaluating across six diverse benchmarks, we demonstrate that: (1) stable model semantics allow LLMs to naturally express default rules and exceptions, outperforming SMT-based alternatives by significant margins on nonmonotonic tasks; (2) iterative self-correction is the primary driver of performance, effectively replacing the need for handcrafted domain knowledge; (3) compact in-context reference guides substantially outperform verbose documentation, revealing a "context rot" phenomenon where excessive context hinders constraint adherence.

AI.tldr: 提出LLM+ASP框架，将自然语言转换为回答集编程（非单调逻辑），通过自动自我纠正循环实现无需人工干预的多样化推理任务，在六个基准测试中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在复杂推理中计算成本高、逻辑不一致、性能下降严重；神经符号方法依赖单调逻辑（如SMT）无法表达可废止推理，且需要大量人工工程。
AI.method: 1) 将自然语言翻译为ASP（基于稳定模型语义的非单调逻辑形式）；2) 无任务特定工程，统一适用于多种推理任务；3) 自动自我纠正循环：ASP求解器的结构化反馈驱动迭代精炼；4) 使用紧凑的上下文参考指南替代冗长文档。
AI.result: 1) 稳定模型语义在非单调任务上显著优于SMT方法；2) 迭代自我修正是性能提升的主要驱动力，可替代手工领域知识；3) 紧凑上下文参考指南优于冗长文档，发现"上下文腐烂"现象。
AI.conclusion: LLM+ASP框架证明了非单调逻辑与LLM结合的有效性，自我纠正机制可替代手工知识工程，为可扩展的神经符号推理提供了新范式。
idea_en: Method for translating natural language into Answer Set Programming (ASP) with stable model semantics for nonmonotonic reasoning
Automated self-correction loop using structured feedback from ASP solver to iteratively refine LLM outputs
Compact in-context reference guide technique that prevents 'context rot' phenomenon in LLM-based reasoning
Unified neuro-symbolic reasoning framework operating without per-task engineering across diverse reasoning tasks

title: Language Models Refine Mechanical Linkage Designs Through Symbolic Reflection and Modular Optimisation
summary: Designing mechanical linkages involves combinatorial topology selection and continuous parameter fitting. We show that language models can systematically improve linkage designs through symbolic representations. Language model agents explore discrete topologies while numerical optimisers fit continuous parameters. A symbolic lifting operator translates simulator trajectories into qualitative descriptors, motion labels, temporal predicates, and structural diagnostics that models interpret across iterative design cycles. Across six engineering-relevant motion targets and three open-source models (Llama 3.3 70B, Qwen3 4B, Qwen3 MoE 30B-A3B), the modular architecture reduces geometric error by up to 68% and improves structural validity by up to 134% over monolithic baselines. Critically, 78.6% of iterative refinement trajectories show measurable improvement, with the system correctly diagnosing overconstraint (56.3%) and underconstraint (35.6%) failure modes and proposing grounded corrections. Models across all three families acquire interpretable mechanical reasoning strategies without fine-tuning, demonstrating that principled symbolic abstraction bridges generative AI and the numerical precision required for engineering design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用语言模型通过符号表示进行连杆机构设计的模块化架构，将拓扑选择与参数优化分离，在六个工程目标上实现误差降低68%、结构有效性提升134%。
AI.motivation: 机械连杆设计需要同时处理离散的拓扑结构选择和连续的参数拟合，传统方法难以兼顾两者，作者希望利用语言模型的推理能力结合数值优化器来解决这一难题。
AI.method: 采用语言模型代理探索离散拓扑结构，数值优化器拟合连续参数；通过符号提升算子将仿真轨迹转换为定性描述、运动标签、时序谓词和结构诊断，供模型在迭代设计循环中理解和使用。
AI.result: 在六个工程运动目标上，使用Llama 3.3 70B、Qwen3 4B、Qwen3 MoE 30B-A3B三个开源模型，几何误差降低68%，结构有效性提升134%；78.6%的迭代轨迹有可测量改进；正确诊断过约束(56.3%)和欠约束(35.6%)失效模式。
AI.conclusion: 无需微调，各类语言模型即可获得可解释的机械推理策略，证明原则性的符号抽象能够桥接生成式AI与工程设计所需的数值精度。
idea_en: A method for mechanical linkage design using language model agents for discrete topology selection combined with numerical optimizers for continuous parameter fitting.
A symbolic lifting operator that converts simulator trajectories into qualitative descriptors, motion labels, temporal predicates, and structural diagnostics for interpretable design feedback.
An iterative refinement architecture for mechanical design where language models interpret symbolic representations to diagnose and correct overconstraint and underconstraint failure modes.
A framework that enables language models to acquire mechanical reasoning strategies without fine-tuning through principled symbolic abstraction.
A modular design system that separates topological exploration from parametric optimization in linkage design, achieving 68% error reduction and 134% structural validity improvement.

title: Splitting Assumption-Based Argumentation Frameworks
summary: Assumption-Based Argumentation (ABA) is a well-established formalism for modelling and reasoning over debates, with a wide range of applications. However, the high computational complexity of core reasoning tasks in ABA poses a significant challenge for its applicability. This issue is further aggravated when ABA frameworks (ABAFs) are instantiated into graph-based argumentation formalisms, such as Dung's Argumentation Frameworks (AFs) and Argumentation Frameworks with Collective Attacks (SETAFs). In knowledge representation and reasoning, a key strategy to address computational intractability is to optimise reasoning over a given knowledge base through divide-and-conquer algorithms. A paradigmatic example of this approach is splitting, where extensions of a given framework are computed incrementally, by restricting the search space to sub-frameworks only, and then combining the obtained results. This approach has been successfully applied to AFs, for which also a parametrised version has been introduced under stable semantics. However, the exponential growth produced by the instantiation might undermine the usefulness of splitting on the argument graphs induced by ABAFs. To address this issue, our work investigates the concept of splitting on the knowledge base rather than on its graph-based instantiation. Furthermore, we generalise splitting to its parametrised version for ABAFs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于假设的论证（ABA）框架中的分割（splitting）概念，提出了在知识库层面而非图实例化层面进行分割的方法，并将其推广到参数化版本，以解决ABA推理的高计算复杂性问题。
AI.motivation: ABA框架的核心推理任务具有高计算复杂性，且ABA框架实例化为图论论证形式（如AF和SETAF）时会进一步加剧复杂度爆炸问题。现有针对AF的分割方法在ABA诱导的参数图上因指数级增长而效果受限。
AI.method: 提出在知识库层面（而非图实例化层面）进行分割，将ABA框架的知识库分解为子部分，分别计算子框架的扩展后再组合结果。同时将分割方法推广到参数化版本（parametrised splitting），应用于ABA框架。
AI.result: 实现了在知识库层面的分割，避免了图实例化带来的指数级增长问题；提出了ABA框架的参数化分割方法，进一步优化了推理效率。
AI.conclusion: 在知识库层面进行分割是解决ABA推理复杂性的有效策略，参数化分割为ABA框架提供了更灵活的优化推理手段。
idea_en: A method for splitting assumption-based argumentation frameworks at the knowledge base level rather than at the graph instantiation level, enabling incremental computation of extensions.
A parametrized splitting approach for assumption-based argumentation frameworks under stable semantics, allowing flexible decomposition and recombination of sub-frameworks.
idea_ch: 一种在知识库层面而非图实例化层面对基于假设的论证框架进行分割的方法，通过将知识库分解为子部分并增量计算扩展，避免图实例化带来的指数级增长问题。
一种基于假设的论证框架的参数化分割方法，在稳定语义下支持灵活的子框架分解与组合，优化推理效率。

title: From LLM-Driven Trading Card Generation to Procedural Relatedness: A Pokémon Case Study
summary:
Since the dawn of Trading Card Games, the genre has grown into a multi-billion-dollar industry engaging millions of analog and digital players worldwide. Popular TCGs rely on regular updates, balance adjustments, and rotating constraints to sustain engagement. Yet, as metagames stabilize, predictable strategies dominate and viable card options diminish, often resulting in repetitive and impaired player experiences.
  This paper investigates the use of Large Language Models and Image Diffusion Models for Procedural Content Generation of TCG cards, addressing these challenges by enabling a personalized infinity of card designs. Modern generative AI not only enables large-scale content creation but could even introduce procedural relatedness, fostering unique connections between players and their cards. We present a pipeline combining player-centric co-creation, fine-tuned embeddings, local LLMs, and Diffusion Models to generate dynamic, personalized cards while potentially expanding creative range.
  We evaluated the pipeline in a user study with 49 participants who generated 196 Pokémon card samples. Participants rated aesthetics and representativeness of visuals and mechanics, and provided qualitative feedback. Results show high satisfaction and indicate that most participants successfully realized their own ideas through prompt adjustments. These findings lay groundwork for future content generation systems and alternatives to conventional metagame evolution through procedural relatedness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合大语言模型和图像扩散模型的流程，用于交易卡牌游戏的程序化内容生成，通过玩家协同创作生成个性化卡牌，实验表明参与者对该方法满意度高。
AI.motivation: 交易卡牌游戏元游戏稳定后会出现策略同质化、可用卡牌减少、玩家体验重复等问题，需要一种能持续生成个性化卡牌内容的方法来维持玩家参与度。
AI.method: 构建一个结合玩家协同创作、微调嵌入、本地大语言模型和扩散模型的流程，利用LLM生成卡牌机制描述，再用扩散模型生成对应视觉内容，支持玩家通过提示词调整实现个性化。
AI.result: 49名参与者生成了196张宝可梦卡牌样本，评估结果显示参与者在视觉美学和机制代表性方面满意度高，多数参与者通过提示词调整成功实现了自己的想法。
AI.conclusion: 该流程为未来内容生成系统和传统元游戏演进提供了替代方案，通过程序化关联增强了玩家与卡牌之间的独特连接。
idea_en: A personalized TCG card generation pipeline combining player co-creation, fine-tuned embeddings, local LLMs, and diffusion models for dynamic card design.
Procedural relatedness mechanism that fosters unique emotional connections between players and AI-generated cards through personalized content.
A prompt-adjustment-based co-creation framework allowing players to iteratively refine both card mechanics text and visual aesthetics in real-time.
Integration of fine-tuned embeddings with local LLMs for generating context-aware TCG card mechanics that align with player intent.
A system for infinite, non-repetitive card content generation in stabilized metagames using generative AI to prevent strategic homogenization.

基于提示词调整的协同创作框架，允许玩家实时迭代优化卡牌机制文本和视觉美学
