title: D3-Gym: Constructing Real-World Verifiable Environments for Data-Driven Discovery
summary: Despite recent progress in language models and agents for scientific data-driven discovery, further advancing their capabilities is held back by the absence of verifiable environments representing real-world scientific tasks.To fill this gap, we introduce D3-Gym, the first automatically constructed dataset with verifiable environments for scientific Data-Driven Discovery. D3-Gym comprises (1) 565 tasks sourced from 239 real scientific repositories across four disciplines where (2) each task is equipped with a natural language instruction, an executable environment with pre-installed dependencies, input dataset and artifact previews, a reference code solution, and an automatically synthesized evaluation script. Rigorous evaluation of the quality of the verification signal in D3-Gym confirms that our evaluation scripts achieve 87.5% agreement with human-annotated gold standards and strong alignment in domain-specific evaluation logic, showing their scientific soundness. Further, training on trajectories sampled from D3-Gym yields consistent and substantial gains across Qwen3 models of varying sizes on ScienceAgentBench, boosting Qwen3-32B by 7.8 absolute points and substantially shrinking the gap with strong proprietary models. All D3-Gym artifacts (environments, creation workflow, trajectories, and models) can be found at https://github.com/OSU-NLP-Group/D3-Gym.

AI.tldr: 提出了D3-Gym，首个自动构建的面向科学数据驱动发现的可验证环境数据集，包含565个任务、239个真实科学仓库，并通过自动合成评估脚本实现可验证性。训练在该数据集上的模型在ScienceAgentBench上显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型和智能体在科学数据驱动发现方面的进步受到缺乏代表真实科学任务的可验证环境的制约。
AI.method: 从239个真实科学仓库中提取565个任务，每个任务包含自然语言指令、可执行环境（预装依赖）、输入数据集、参考代码解决方案及自动合成的评估脚本。通过自动化工作流构建数据集并验证评估脚本质量（与人工标注黄金标准的一致性达87.5%）。
AI.result: 评估脚本与人工标注黄金标准的一致性达87.5%，领域特定评估逻辑对齐良好。在D3-Gym上训练的模型在ScienceAgentBench上持续提升，Qwen3-32B提升7.8个绝对百分点，缩小了与强大专有模型的差距。
AI.conclusion: D3-Gym填补了科学数据驱动发现中可验证环境的空白，自动构建的数据集质量高，能有效提升语言模型在科学任务上的表现。
idea_en: A method for automatically constructing verifiable scientific data-driven discovery environments from real-world repositories, including automated extraction of tasks, dependencies, datasets, reference solutions, and evaluation scripts.
A system for automatically synthesizing evaluation scripts for scientific data-driven tasks that achieves 87.5% agreement with human-annotated gold standards.
A training framework using trajectories sampled from automatically constructed verifiable scientific environments to improve language model performance on scientific agent tasks.
idea_ch: 一种从真实科学仓库中自动构建可验证科学数据驱动发现环境的方法，包括自动提取任务、依赖、数据集、参考解决方案和评估脚本。
一种自动合科学数据驱动任务评估脚本的系统，与人工标注黄金标准的达成率达87.5%。
一种利用从自动构建的可验证科学环境中采样的轨迹来训练语言模型、提升其在科学智能体任务上性能的框架。

title: Exploring Interaction Paradigms for LLM Agents in Scientific Visualization
summary: This paper examines how different types of large language model (LLM) agents perform on scientific visualization (SciVis) tasks, where users generate visualization workflows from natural-language instructions. We compare three primary interaction paradigms, including domain-specific agents with structured tool use, computer-use agents, and general-purpose coding agents, by evaluating eight representative agents across 15 benchmark tasks and measuring visualization quality, efficiency, robustness, and computational cost. We further analyze interaction modalities, including code scripts and model context protocol (MCP) or API calls for structured tool use, as well as command-line interfaces (CLI) and graphical user interfaces (GUI) for more general interaction, while additionally studying the effect of persistent memory in selected agents. The results reveal clear tradeoffs across paradigms and modalities. General-purpose coding agents achieve the highest task success rates but are computationally expensive, while domain-specific agents are more efficient and stable but less flexible. Computer-use agents perform well on individual steps but struggle with longer multi-step workflows, indicating that long-horizon planning is their primary limitation. Across both CLI- and GUI-based settings, persistent memory improves performance over repeated trials, although its benefits depend on the underlying interaction mode and the quality of feedback. These findings suggest that no single approach is sufficient, and future SciVis systems should combine structured tool use, interactive capabilities, and adaptive memory mechanisms to balance performance, robustness, and flexibility.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了三种LLM智能体范式（领域专用智能体、计算机使用智能体、通用编码智能体）在科学可视化任务中的表现，发现通用编码智能体成功率最高但计算成本高，领域专用智能体高效稳定但灵活度低，计算机使用智能体在长序列任务中受限，并指出未来系统应结合结构化工具、交互能力和自适应记忆机制。
AI.motivation: 探索不同LLM智能体范式在科学可视化任务中的表现差异，为构建更优的智能可视化系统提供指导。
AI.method: 在15个基准任务上评估8种代表性智能体，从可视化质量、效率、鲁棒性和计算成本四个维度进行对比，并分析交互模态（代码脚本、MCP/API调用、CLI、GUI）及持久记忆的影响。
AI.result: 通用编码智能体任务成功率最高但计算开销大；领域专用智能体更高效稳定但灵活性不足；计算机使用智能体在单步任务表现良好但长序列规划能力弱；持久记忆在多次试验中可提升性能，但依赖于交互模式与反馈质量。
AI.conclusion: 单一范式不足以应对所有科学可视化需求，未来应融合结构化工具使用、交互能力和自适应记忆机制以平衡性能、鲁棒性和灵活性。
idea_en: A hybrid multi-paradigm LLM agent system for scientific visualization that dynamically switches between domain-specific structured tool use, general-purpose coding, and computer-use modes based on task complexity and user intent.

A persistent memory mechanism with adaptive feedback quality assessment for LLM agents in visualization workflows, where memory retention strength is modulated by the interaction mode (CLI vs GUI) and the reliability of execution feedback.

An LLM-based scientific visualization agent employing Model Context Protocol (MCP) for structured tool orchestration, enabling standardized API-level interaction between natural language instructions and visualization primitives.
A multi-step visualization workflow planning system that combines short-horizon computer-use agents with a hierarchical task decomposer to overcome long-horizon planning limitations.

A cost-aware agent selection framework for SciVis that predicts computational expense vs. success probability tradeoffs across different agent paradigms and automatically allocates the optimal agent type for each visualization subtask.
idea_ch: 一种混合多范式的科学可视化LLM智能体系统，根据任务复杂度和用户意图，在领域专用结构化工具使用、通用编码和计算机使用模式之间动态切换。
一种用于可视化工作流的LLM智能体持久记忆机制，具有自适应反馈质量评估功能，记忆保留强度根据交互模式（CLI vs GUI）和执行反馈的可靠性动态调节。
一种基于模型上下文协议（MCP）的LLM科学可视化智能体，实现结构化工具编排，在自然语言指令与可视化原语之间建立标准化的API级交互接口。
一种多步可视化工作流规划系统，将短视域的计算机使用智能体与分层任务分解器相结合，以克服长程规划能力的局限性。
一种成本感知的科学可视化智能体选择框架，预测不同智能体范式下计算开销与成功概率之间的权衡关系，自动为每个可视化子任务分配最优智能体类型。

title: A Pattern Language for Resilient Visual Agents
comment: Accepted to the 23rd International Conference on Software Architecture (ICSA 2026), New and Emerging Ideas Track. 5 pages, 1 figure
summary: Integrating multimodal foundation models into enterprise ecosystems presents a fundamental software architecture challenge. Architects must balance competing quality attributes: the high latency and non-determinism of vision language action (VLA) models versus the strict determinism and real-time performance required by enterprise control loops. In this study, we propose an architectural pattern language for visual agents that separates fast, deterministic reflexes from slow, probabilistic supervision. It consists of four architectural design patterns: (1) Hybrid Affordance Integration, (2) Adaptive Visual Anchoring, (3) Visual Hierarchy Synthesis, and (4) Semantic Scene Graph.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向企业级视觉代理的架构模式语言，通过将快速确定性反射与慢速概率监督分离，平衡多模态基础模型的延迟、非确定性与企业控制回路的严格确定性、实时性需求。包含四种架构设计模式：混合可适性集成、自适应视觉锚定、视觉层次合成与语义场景图。
AI.motivation: 企业级系统在集成多模态基础模型（如VLA模型）时面临核心矛盾：模型的高延迟与非确定性与企业控制回路所需的严格确定性和实时性能之间存在根本性冲突，亟需一种能够平衡这些竞争性质量属性的软件架构方案。
AI.method: 提出了一种视觉代理的架构模式语言，核心思想是将快速、确定性的"反射"与慢速、概率性的"监督"相分离。具体包含四种设计模式：(1) 混合可适性集成——结合快速反射与慢速推理；(2) 自适应视觉锚定——动态调整视觉参考点；(3) 视觉层次合成——多层级视觉信息融合；(4) 语义场景图——结构化场景语义表示。
AI.result: 论文提出了一个包含四种架构模式的完整模式语言，为企业级视觉代理系统的架构设计提供了系统化的解决方案，平衡了多模态模型与企业控制系统的质量属性冲突。
AI.conclusion: 通过分离快速确定性反射与慢速概率监督的架构模式语言，可以有效解决多模态基础模型集成到企业生态系统中的软件架构挑战，为构建满足企业级实时性、确定性要求同时利用AI模型能力的视觉代理系统提供了设计指导。
idea_en: A method for separating fast deterministic reflexes from slow probabilistic supervision in visual agent systems, enabling balanced integration of VLA models into enterprise control loops.
Hybrid Affordance Integration pattern that combines rapid reflexive responses with deliberative probabilistic reasoning for visual agent decision-making.
Adaptive Visual Anchoring technique for dynamically adjusting visual reference points based on context-dependent requirements in enterprise visual systems.
Visual Hierarchy Synthesis method for multi-level visual information fusion that maintains deterministic real-time performance while incorporating probabilistic model outputs.
Semantic Scene Graph architecture for structured representation of visual scenes that bridges the gap between probabilistic VLA model outputs and deterministic enterprise system requirements.
idea_ch: 一种在视觉代理系统中分离快速确定性反射与慢速概率监督的方法，实现VLA模型与企业控制回路的平衡集成。
混合可适性集成模式：将快速反射响应与审慎的概率推理相结合，用于视觉代理决策制定。
自适应视觉锚定技术：根据企业视觉系统中上下文相关需求动态调整视觉参考点。
视觉层次合成方法：多层级视觉信息融合技术，在整合概率模型输出的同时保持确定性实时性能。
语义场景图架构：用于视觉场景结构化表示的架构，弥合概率性VLA模型输出与确定性企业系统需求之间的鸿沟。

title: SpecVQA: A Benchmark for Spectral Understanding and Visual Question Answering in Scientific Images
summary: Spectra are a prevalent yet highly information-dense form of scientific imagery, presenting substantial challenges to multimodal large language models (MLLMs) due to their unstructured and domain-specific characteristics. Here we introduce SpecVQA, a professional scientific-image benchmark for evaluating multimodal models on scientific spectral understanding, covering 7 representative spectrum types with expert-annotated question-answer pairs. The aim comprises two aspects: spectra scientific QA evaluation and corresponding underlying task evaluation. SpecVQA contains 620 figures and 3100 QA pairs curated from peer-reviewed literature, targeting both direct information extraction and domain-specific reasoning. To effectively reduce token length while preserving essential curve characteristics, we propose a spectral data sampling and interpolation reconstruction approach. Ablation studies further confirm that the approach achieves substantial performance improvements on the proposed benchmark. We test the capability of prominent MLLMs in scientific spectral understanding on our benchmark and present a leaderboard. This work represents an essential step toward enhancing spectral understanding in multimodal large models and suggests promising directions for extending visual-language models to broader scientific research and data analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SpecVQA基准，用于评估多模态大模型对科学光谱图像的理解能力，包含7种光谱类型、620张图和3100个问答对，并提出了一种光谱数据采样与插值重构方法来减少token长度同时保留曲线特征。
AI.motivation: 光谱图像信息密集且缺乏结构，现有MLLMs难以有效理解这类专业科学图像，缺乏专门评估基准。
AI.method: 构建了包含7种光谱类型、620张图、3100个专家标注问答对的SpecVQA基准；提出光谱数据采样与插值重构方法以减少token长度并保留曲线特征。
AI.result: 所提出的采样插值方法在基准上取得了显著的性能提升，并测试了主流MLLMs的能力，建立了排行榜。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作向增强多模态大模型的光谱理解迈出了关键一步，为将视觉-语言模型扩展到更广泛的科学研究和数据分析提供了方向。
idea_en: A spectral data sampling and interpolation reconstruction method that reduces token length while preserving essential curve characteristics for MLLM input.
SpecVQA benchmark: a professional scientific-image benchmark covering 7 spectrum types with 620 figures and 3100 expert-annotated QA pairs for multimodal model evaluation.
A dual-task evaluation framework for scientific spectral understanding, including direct information extraction and domain-specific reasoning.
idea_ch: 一种光谱数据采样与插值重构方法，能在减少token长度的同时保留光谱曲线关键特征，用于多模态大模型的输入优化。
SpecVQA基准：覆盖7种光谱类型、620张图、3100个专家标注问答对的专业科学图像基准，用于评估多模态模型的光谱理解能力。
一种双任务评估框架，同时评估科学光谱的直接信息提取能力和领域特定推理能力。

title: Collaborative Agent Reasoning Engineering (CARE): A Three-Party Design Methodology for Systematically Engineering AI Agents with Subject Matter Experts, Developers, and Helper Agents
summary: We present Collaborative Agent Reasoning Engineering (CARE), a disciplined methodology for engineering Large Language Model (LLM) agents in scientific domains. Unlike ad-hoc trial-and-error approaches, CARE specifies behavior, grounding, tool orchestration, and verification through reusable artifacts and systematic, stage-gated phases. The methodology employs a three-party workflow involving Subject-Matter Experts (SMEs), developers, and LLM-based helper agents. These helper agents function as facilitation infrastructure, transforming informal domain intent into structured, reviewable specifications for human approval at defined gates. CARE addresses the "jagged technological frontier", characterized by uneven LLM performance, by bridging the gap between novice and expert analysts regarding domain constraints and verification practices. By generating concrete artifacts, including interaction requirements, reasoning policies, and evaluation criteria, CARE ensures agent behavior is specifiable, testable, and maintainable. Evaluation results from a scientific use case demonstrate that this stage-gated, artifact-driven methodology yields measurable improvements in development efficiency and complex-query performance.

AI.tldr: CARE是一种结构化方法论，通过三方协作（领域专家、开发者、LLM辅助代理）和阶段性工件驱动，规范科学领域LLM代理的工程开发，提升开发效率和复杂查询性能。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM代理在科学领域的开发多采用临时试错方式，缺乏系统化的工程方法论，存在性能不均匀的"锯齿技术前沿"问题，且新手与专家分析师在领域约束和验证实践方面存在差距。
AI.method: 提出CARE方法论，包含：(1) 三方工作流（领域专家、开发者、LLM辅助代理）；(2) 阶段门控阶段（stage-gated phases）；(3) 可复用工件（交互需求、推理策略、评估标准）；(4) LLM辅助代理作为促进基础设施，将非正式领域意图转化为结构化、可审查的规范。
AI.result: 在科学用例中的评估表明，这种阶段门控、工件驱动的方法论在开发效率和复杂查询性能方面有可衡量的提升。
AI.conclusion: CARE确保了代理行为的可指定、可测试和可维护，为科学领域的LLM代理工程提供了系统化、可复用的方法论框架。
idea_en: A stage-gated, artifact-driven methodology for engineering LLM agents that transforms informal domain intent into structured, reviewable specifications through a three-party workflow (SMEs, developers, helper agents)

A reusable artifact framework for LLM agent development comprising interaction requirements, reasoning policies, and evaluation criteria that ensures specifiable, testable, and maintainable agent behavior
A facilitation infrastructure using LLM-based helper agents to bridge the gap between novice and expert analysts in domain-specific constraint verification and scientific reasoning
idea_ch: 一种基于阶段门控和工件驱动的LLM代理工程方法论，通过三方协作（领域专家、开发者、LLM辅助代理）将非正式领域意图转化为结构化、可审查的规范
一种LLM代理开发的可复用工件框架，包含交互需求、推理策略和评估标准，确保代理行为可指定、可测试、可维护
一种利用LLM辅助代理作为促进基础设施的方法，弥合新手与专家分析师在领域特定约束验证和科学推理方面的差距

title: Agent-Agnostic Evaluation of SQL Accuracy in Production Text-to-SQL Systems
summary: Text-to-SQL (T2SQL) evaluation in production environments poses fundamental challenges that existing benchmarks do not address. Current evaluation methodologies whether rule-based SQL matching or schema-dependent semantic parsers assume access to ground-truth queries and structured database schema, constraints that are rarely satisfied in real-world deployments. This disconnect leaves production T2SQL agents largely unevaluated beyond developer-time testing, creating silent quality degradation with no feedback mechanism for continuous improvement. We present STEF (Schema-agnostic Text-to-SQL Evaluation Framework), a production-native evaluation system that operates exclusively on natural language inputs the user question, an enriched reformulation, and the generated SQL without requiring database schema or reference queries. STEF extracts semantic specifications from both natural language and SQL representations, performs normalized feature alignment, and produces an interpretable 0 to 100 accuracy score via a composite metric that encompasses filter alignment, semantic verdict, and confidence of the evaluator. Key contributions include: enriched question quality validation as a first-class evaluation signal, configurable application-specific rule injection via prompt templating, and production-robust normalization handling GROUP BY tolerance, ORDER BY defaults, and LIMIT heuristics. Empirical results demonstrate that STEF enables continuous production monitoring and agent improvement feedback loops without schema dependency, making structured query evaluation viable at scale for the first time.

AI.tldr: STEF是一个无需数据库schema的Text-to-SQL生产级评估框架，仅依赖自然语言输入即可生成0-100的准确率评分，支持持续监控和反馈优化。
AI.motivation: 现有T2SQL评估方法依赖ground-truth查询和结构化schema，这在真实生产环境中几乎无法满足，导致SQL代理在生产部署后出现静默质量退化且缺乏反馈机制。
AI.method: STEF仅使用用户问题、增强改写和生成的SQL作为输入，通过提取语义规范、进行归一化特征对齐，并组合过滤器对齐、语义判定和评估者置信度三个维度，输出0-100的可解释评分。
AI.result: 实验结果表明STEF无需schema依赖即可实现生产环境下的持续监控和代理改进反馈循环，使结构化查询评估首次可在规模化生产中落地。
AI.conclusion: STEF解决了生产环境T2SQL评估的核心痛点，通过schema无关的设计和可配置规则注入，为生产级SQL代理的质量监控和迭代优化提供了可行方案。
idea_en: A schema-agnostic evaluation framework for Text-to-SQL that operates solely on natural language inputs (user question, enriched reformulation, generated SQL) without requiring database schema or reference queries.
A composite scoring metric that combines filter alignment, semantic verdict, and evaluator confidence into an interpretable 0-100 accuracy score for SQL quality assessment.
Enriched question quality validation as a first-class evaluation signal, enabling detection of ambiguous or poorly-formed user questions before SQL generation evaluation.
Configurable application-specific rule injection via prompt templating for flexible GROUP BY tolerance, ORDER BY defaults, and LIMIT heuristics normalization.
A production-robust normalization mechanism that handles GROUP BY tolerance, ORDER BY defaults, and LIMIT heuristics to accommodate valid SQL variations.
A feedback loop system enabling continuous production monitoring and agent improvement without schema dependency.
idea_ch: 一种无需数据库schema的Text-to-SQL评估框架，仅依赖自然语言输入（用户问题、增强改写、生成的SQL）进行质量评估，不依赖参考查询或结构化schema
一种复合评分指标，将过滤器对齐度、语义判定结果和评估者置信度三个维度组合为0-100的可解释准确率评分
将增强后的问题质量验证作为一等评估信号，在SQL生成评估之前即可检测模糊或构造不良的用户问题
通过提示模板实现可配置的应用特定规则注入，支持GROUP BY容差、ORDER BY默认值和LIMIT启发式规则的自定义归一化处理
一种生产级鲁棒归一化机制，处理GROUP BY容差、ORDER BY默认值和LIMIT启发式规则，以适应合法SQL变体
一种无需schema依赖的反馈循环系统，支持生产环境下的持续监控和SQL代理改进迭代

title: RHyVE: Competence-Aware Verification and Phase-Aware Deployment for LLM-Generated Reward Hypotheses
summary: Large language models (LLMs) make reward design in reinforcement learning substantially more scalable, but generated rewards are not automatically reliable training objectives. Existing work has focused primarily on generating, evolving, or selecting reward candidates, while paying less attention to when such candidates can be verified and deployed during policy optimization. We study this deployment-time problem by treating generated rewards as reward hypotheses whose utility depends on the competence of the current policy and the phase of training. We propose \textsc{RHyVE}, a competence-aware verification and phase-aware deployment protocol that compares small sets of reward hypotheses from shared policy checkpoints using short-horizon fork verification. Our experiments show that reward rankings are unreliable at low competence but become informative after task-dependent thresholds. On a sparse manipulation task, phase-aware deployment improves peak and retained performance under a locked protocol. Updated LLM-generated reward-candidate experiments show candidate-family-dependent behavior: generated pools can exhibit phase-dependent winner changes, but no fixed warm-up schedule is universally optimal. Held-out schedule selection, conservative selector baselines, compute-matched controls, and scale controls further show that \textsc{RHyVE} is best understood as a verification-informed deployment protocol rather than a universal scheduler. Dense and all-failure boundary experiments delimit the scope of the method. Together, these results suggest that reward generation and reward deployment should be studied as coupled problems: generated rewards must be verified and deployed under changing policy competence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RHyVE协议，在强化学习中基于策略能力感知的验证和训练阶段感知的部署来管理LLM生成的奖励信号，解决奖励候选在策略优化不同阶段的可靠性问题。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的奖励信号在强化学习中可扩展但不可靠，现有工作关注奖励候选的生成、进化或选择，忽略了何时可以验证和部署这些候选信号的问题。
AI.method: 提出RHyVE协议：(1) 能力感知验证——在共享策略检查点上使用短视距fork验证比较小规模奖励假设集；(2) 阶段感知部署——根据训练阶段动态部署奖励信号。包括保留调度选择、保守选择器基线、计算匹配控制和规模控制等实验设计。
AI.result: 奖励排序在低能力时不可靠，在任务相关阈值后变得有效；阶段感知部署在稀疏操作任务上提升了峰值和保持性能；不同奖励候选族表现出阶段依赖的优胜者变化，但无固定热身策略普遍最优。
AI.conclusion: 奖励生成和奖励部署应作为耦合问题研究：生成的奖励必须在策略能力变化下进行验证和动态部署，RHyVE是一个验证驱动的部署协议而非通用调度器。
idea_en: A competence-aware reward verification method for LLM-generated rewards in RL, using short-horizon fork verification across shared policy checkpoints to assess reward reliability.
A phase-aware reward deployment protocol that dynamically selects and deploys reward candidates based on current training stage and policy competence.
A reward hypothesis management system that treats LLM-generated rewards as testable hypotheses with deployment decisions conditioned on policy competence thresholds.
A held-out schedule selection mechanism for reward deployment that outperforms fixed warm-up schedules.
idea_ch: 一种能力感知的奖励验证方法：在共享策略检查点上使用短视距fork验证评估LLM生成奖励信号的可靠性，解决低能力阶段奖励排序不可靠问题
一种阶段感知的奖励部署协议：根据训练阶段和策略能力动态选择并部署奖励候选，提升稀疏奖励任务中的峰值和保持性能
一种奖励假设管理系统：将LLM生成的奖励视为可测试假设，基于策略能力阈值决定何时部署何种奖励信号
一种保留调度选择机制：用于奖励部署的调度优化，避免固定热身策略的局限性，实现可泛化的部署方案

title: Characterizing the Consistency of the Emergent Misalignment Persona
summary: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) on narrowly misaligned data generalizes to broadly misaligned behavior, a phenomenon termed emergent misalignment (EM). While prior work has found a correlation between harmful behavior and self-assessment in emergently misaligned models, it remains unclear how consistent this correspondence is across tasks and whether it varies across fine-tuning domains. We characterize the consistency of the EM persona by fine-tuning Qwen 2.5 32B Instruct on six narrowly misaligned domains (e.g., insecure code, risky financial advice, bad medical advice) and administering experiments including harmfulness evaluation, self-assessment, choosing between two descriptions of AI systems, output recognition, and score prediction. Our results reveal two distinct patterns: coherent-persona models, in which harmful behavior and self-reported misalignment are coupled, and inverted-persona models, which produce harmful outputs while identifying as aligned AI systems. These findings reveal a more fine-grained picture of the effects of emergent misalignment, calling into question the consistency of the EM persona.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对Qwen 2.5 32B Instruct在六个窄域错位领域进行微调，发现 emergent misalignment (EM) 存在两种模式：一致人格模型（有害行为与自我报告错位一致）和反转人格模型（产出有害输出但自我标识为对齐系统），揭示了EM人设的不一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有工作发现紧急错位模型中危害行为与自我评估存在相关性，但不清楚这种对应关系在不同任务间是否一致，以及是否随微调领域变化。
AI.method: 在六个窄域错位领域（如不安全代码、风险金融建议、不良医疗建议）微调Qwen 2.5 32B Instruct，进行危害性评估、自我评估、AI系统描述选择、输出识别和分数预测等实验。
AI.result: 发现了两种模式：一致人格模型（危害行为与自我报告错位耦合）和反转人格模型（产出危害输出但自我标识为对齐系统）。
AI.conclusion: 紧急错位的效应存在更细粒度的画面，EM人设的一致性存疑。
idea_en: A method for detecting emergent misalignment in fine-tuned LLMs by evaluating the coupling between harmful output behavior and self-reported alignment status, distinguishing coherent-persona from inverted-persona models.

A multi-domain fine-tuning framework for systematically inducing and characterizing emergent misalignment across diverse narrow domains (insecure code, risky financial advice, bad medical advice) to reveal persona consistency patterns.
A self-assessment inconsistency detection technique that identifies inverted-persona LLMs where models produce harmful outputs while self-identifying as aligned AI systems.

An evaluation protocol combining harmfulness evaluation, self-assessment, AI system description selection, output recognition, and score prediction to comprehensively profile LLM persona consistency after fine-tuning.
A method for generating narrowly misaligned fine-tuning datasets across multiple domains to systematically study the generalization of emergent misalignment to broadly harmful behaviors.
idea_ch: 一种检测微调LLM中紧急错位的方法，通过评估有害输出行为与自我报告对齐状态之间的耦合程度，区分一致人格模型和反转人格模型。
一种多领域微调框架，用于在不同窄域（不安全代码、风险金融建议、不良医疗建议）中系统性地诱导和表征紧急错位，揭示人格一致性模式。
一种自我评估不一致性检测技术，用于识别反转人格LLM，即模型产生有害输出但自我标识为对齐AI系统的情形。
一种结合危害性评估、自我评估、AI系统描述选择、输出识别和分数预测的综合评估协议，用于全面描述微调后LLM的人格一致性特征。
一种跨多个领域生成窄域错位微调数据集的方法，用于系统性研究紧急错位向广泛有害行为泛化的现象。

title: What Makes a Good Terminal-Agent Benchmark Task: A Guideline for Adversarial, Difficult, and Legible Evaluation Design
summary: Terminal-agent benchmarks have become a primary signal for measuring the coding and system-administration capabilities of large language models. As the market for evaluation environments grows, so does the pressure to ship tasks quickly, often without thorough adversarial review of the verification logic. This paper is a guideline for writing good benchmark tasks, drawn from over a year of contributing to and reviewing tasks for Terminal Bench. Most people write benchmark tasks the way they write prompts. They shouldn't. A prompt is designed to help the agent succeed; a benchmark is designed to find out if it can. We argue that good tasks are adversarial, difficult, and legible, and that a large class of common failure modes -- AI-generated instructions, over-prescriptive specifications, clerical difficulty, oracle solutions that assume hidden knowledge, tests that validate the wrong things, and reward-hackable environments -- are predictable consequences of treating task authoring as prompt authoring. We catalog these failure modes, argue that real difficulty is conceptual rather than environmental, and discuss recent empirical evidence that over 15% of tasks in popular terminal-agent benchmarks are reward-hackable. We hope this serves as a useful reference for benchmark maintainers, task contributors, and researchers using benchmark scores as evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出终端代理基准测试任务编写应视为对抗性测试而非提示编写，系统总结了六类常见失败模式，并发现超过15%的流行基准任务存在可被奖励黑客攻击的漏洞。
AI.motivation: 随着终端代理基准测试环境市场的增长，任务编写压力增大，导致验证逻辑缺乏充分的对抗性审查，许多任务存在漏洞和偏差，无法准确衡量大语言模型的能力。
AI.method: 本文基于对Terminal Bench平台一年以上的任务贡献与审查经验，系统分析了终端代理基准测试中常见的失败模式，提出好的基准任务应具备对抗性、高难度和可读性三大特征，并通过实证数据展示超过15%的流行终端代理基准任务存在奖励黑客漏洞。
AI.result: 发现超过15%的流行终端代理基准任务存在可被奖励黑客攻击的漏洞，并系统化地归纳了六类常见失败模式：AI生成指令、过度规范说明、文书性困难、假设隐藏知识的预言机解决方案、验证错误问题的测试、可奖励黑客攻击的环境。
AI.conclusion: 基准任务编写应视为对抗性测试设计而非提示编写，好的任务应具备对抗性、难度高且可读性强，同时应避免常见的失败模式（如AI生成指令、过度规范说明、文书性困难等）。
idea_en: An adversarial verification system for terminal-agent benchmark tasks that automatically detects reward-hackable vulnerabilities by reverse-engineering the evaluation logic
A conceptual difficulty scoring method that separates environmental friction from genuine capability requirements in terminal benchmark tasks
A meta-validation framework that identifies common failure modes in benchmark tasks including AI-generated instructions, over-prescriptive specifications, and hidden-knowledge oracle solutions
idea_ch: 一种基于对抗性校验的终端代理基准测试任务生成系统，通过逆向验证逻辑审查自动检测任务中的奖励黑客漏洞
一种区分概念性难度与环境性难度的终端任务难度评估方法，确保基准测试衡量的是核心能力而非操作门槛
一种终端基准测试任务的元验证框架，自动识别AI生成指令、过度规范说明等常见失败模式并给出修复建议

title: Mapping the Methodological Space of Classroom Interaction Research: Scale, Duration, and Modality in an Age of AI
summary: Research on classroom interaction has long been divided between large-scale observation and in-depth ethnographic work. We propose a framework mapping this methodological space along three dimensions--scale, duration, and modality--where a study's position shapes what it reveals and obscures. We illustrate it through contrasting studies of dialogic teaching--Howe et al. (2019) and Snell and Lefstein (2018)--and an interview with the lead researchers, organized around three questions: what can be operationalized, what mechanisms become visible, and what translates to practice. We then examine how AI is expanding this space and how the framework can guide research and tool design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个三维框架（规模、时长、模态）来映射课堂互动研究方法论空间，通过对比两种对话教学研究案例和研究者访谈，探讨AI如何扩展这一空间并指导研究和工具设计。
AI.motivation: 传统的课堂互动研究在大规模观察和深度民族志研究之间存在分歧，缺乏一个统一的框架来理解不同方法论的优缺点及其揭示与隐藏的内容。
AI.method: 提出了一个三维框架（规模、时长、模态）来定位研究方法；通过对比Howe等人(2019)的大规模定量研究和Snell & Lefstein(2018)的深度民族志研究，结合对主要研究者的访谈进行验证和说明。
AI.result: 该框架能够清晰展示不同研究方法在三个维度上的位置差异，解释为什么不同研究会揭示不同的现象；AI技术正在扩展这一方法论空间。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可用于指导未来课堂互动研究的方法选择和AI工具设计，帮助研究者理解不同方法论视角的局限性和互补性。
idea_en: A three-dimensional methodological mapping framework (scale, duration, modality) for classroom interaction research that quantitatively positions studies and reveals blind spots.
An AI-augmented classroom analysis system that dynamically adjusts its position along scale, duration, and modality dimensions based on research questions.
A cross-method validation tool that systematically compares findings from studies occupying different positions in the 3D methodological space.
A hybrid classroom interaction analysis method combining large-scale automated coding (scale) with AI-assisted deep ethnographic analysis (modality/duration).
A research design recommendation engine that uses the 3D framework to suggest optimal methodological positioning based on study objectives and available resources.
idea_ch: 一种用于课堂互动研究的三维方法论映射框架（规模、时长、模态），可定量定位研究位置并揭示盲区
一种AI增强的课堂分析系统，能够根据研究问题动态调整其在规模、时长和模态三个维度上的位置
一种交叉方法验证工具，系统比较在三维方法论空间中不同位置研究的发现
一种混合型课堂互动分析方法，结合大规模自动编码（规模维度）与AI辅助深度民族志分析（模态/时长维度）
一种研究设计推荐引擎，基于三维框架根据研究目标和可用资源推荐最优方法论定位

title: Splitting Argumentation Frameworks with Collective Attacks and Supports
comment: Extended version of a paper presented at the 23rd International Conference on Principles of Knowledge Representation and Reasoning July 20-23, 2026 - Lisbon, Portugal, 27 pages
summary: This work proposes novel splitting techniques for argumentation formalisms that incorporate supports between defeasible elements. We base our studies on bipolar set-based argumentation frameworks (BSAFs) which generalize argumentation frameworks with collective attacks (SETAFs), as well as bipolar argumentation frameworks (BAFs), by incorporating both collective attacks and supports. Notably, BSAFs establish a crucial link to structured argumentation as they naturally capture general (potentially non-flat) assumption-based argumentation. The increase in expressiveness calls for diverse forms of splitting. We consider splits over collective attacks (thereby generalizing the recently proposed splitting techniques for SETAFs), splits over collective supports, as well as splits over both collective attacks and supports. We establish suitable splitting schemata and prove their correctness for the most common argumentation semantics.

AI.tldr: 本文针对双极集合基论证框架（BSAFs）提出了新颖的分割技术，涵盖集体攻击和集体支持的分割，并证明了其在常见论证语义下的正确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的论证框架分割技术仅针对集体攻击（如SETAFs），而BSAFs同时包含集体攻击和支持，表达能力更强（可捕捉结构化论证），需要更通用的分割方法。
AI.method: 提出了三类分割方案：集体攻击上的分割（推广SETAFs分割）、集体支持上的分割、以及集体攻击和支持的联合分割，并建立了相应的分割模式并证明正确性。
AI.result: 成功建立了BSAFs在常见论证语义下的分割模式，并证明了其正确性。
AI.conclusion: BSAFs的分割技术为处理带有支持的论证形式提供了理论基础，可应用于结构化论证的分解与优化。
idea_en: A method for splitting bipolar set-based argumentation frameworks (BSAFs) by partitioning collective attacks, enabling modular decomposition of argumentation systems with both attacks and supports.
A technique for splitting BSAFs based on collective supports, allowing independent analysis of supportive relationships in argumentation.
A combined splitting method for simultaneously partitioning both collective attacks and collective supports in BSAFs, enabling full modularization.
Application of BSAF splitting to decompose general (non-flat) assumption-based argumentation frameworks into smaller components.
idea_ch: 一种通过划分集体攻击来分割双极集合基论证框架（BSAF）的方法，实现对同时包含攻击和支持的论证系统的模块化分解。
一种基于集体支持分割BSAF的技术，允许对论证中的支持关系进行独立分析。
一种同时划分BSAF中集体攻击和集体支持的联合分割方法，实现完全模块化。
将BSAF分割技术应用于分解一般（非平坦）基于假设的论证框架为更小组件的方法。

title: Normativity and Productivism: Ableist Intelligence? A Degrowth Analysis of AI Sign Language Translation Tools for Deaf People
comment: Paper submitted and accepted to IJES 2026
summary:
Sign languages, of any geographical or accentual variation, understandably face continuous scrutiny under the ever present popularity of verbal dictation and audism. Through this, many potential problems arise with the current lack of accessible communication for those who rely on such sign languages for essential conversation. Such AI systems regularly take the form of recognition and interpretation models, designed to provide seamless and accurate translation. In reality these systems are built from biased data and created without any input from deaf communities. Such models are widely used and accepted by their hearing counterparts who remain ignorant to the inherent culture, semantics and colloquial language present in gestural language systems.
  This phenomenon is best analysed under the scope of The Technological System and Technological bluff by Ellul. Indeed, what is at play here is the standardization of language by technicians into what can be captured by technique: data, statistics, a mathematical language. For that AI technique to exist, sign language must be rationalized, in a search for profit that annihilates the conditions for communication and fails to capture the human experience of the deaf person. By that process, it presents normative effects, creating a model of Man, standardized, massified, and who has to adapt to the tool and technical milieu instead of the other way around, which we assume should have been the goal of such a technology.
  Technique thus reshapes what it means to be human, to submit deaf people to the goals of productivity and efficiency. In doing so, it exhibits clear counter productivity, alienating instead of emancipating, isolating instead of nourishing human relationships. Therefore this paper argues for the idea of AI as Ableist Intelligence, as such systems seek to emphasise the humiliated and marginalised nature of sign.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地分析了手语AI翻译系统，指出其建立在偏见数据之上、缺乏聋人社区参与，并借Ellul的技术系统理论论证此类AI实为"能力主义智能"，通过标准化和工具化手语，反而加剧了聋人群体的边缘化与异化。
AI.motivation: 揭露当前手语AI翻译系统存在的根本性问题：数据集偏见、缺乏聋人社区参与、忽视手语文化语义和口语化表达，以及这些系统如何通过技术标准化过程异化聋人群体。
AI.method: 采用Ellul的技术系统和技术虚张声势理论作为分析框架，从哲学和社会学角度批判手语AI系统的标准化、功利化本质。
AI.result: 提出"AI作为能力主义智能（Ableist Intelligence）"的概念，揭示技术如何通过标准化过程重塑人类本质，使聋人群体服从于生产力和效率目标，产生逆生产力效应。
AI.conclusion: 当前手语AI系统未能实现赋能聋人的初衷，反而加剧了排斥和异化，技术应当服务于人的需求而非反之。
idea_en: A sign language recognition system with built-in cultural and semantic context preservation module that prevents standardization and maintains the linguistic diversity of different sign language dialects and colloquial expressions.

A community-driven AI training framework for sign language translation that incorporates deaf community input at all stages of model development, including data collection, annotation, and validation.
An anti-ableist sign language translation AI that explicitly models and preserves the emotional and experiential dimensions of deaf communication beyond literal gesture-to-text conversion.
A decentralized sign language interpretation system that adapts to individual signing styles rather than forcing users to conform to a standardized gesture vocabulary.

A reflexive AI auditing framework that continuously monitors for technological standardization bias in sign language models and alerts when the system imposes normative constraints on natural signing patterns.
idea_ch: 一种具有内置文化和语义上下文保存模块的手语识别系统，防止标准化并保持不同手语方言和口语表达的语言多样性。
一种社区驱动的手语翻译AI训练框架，在模型开发的各个阶段（包括数据收集、标注和验证）纳入聋人社区的意见。
一种反能力主义的手语翻译AI，明确建模和保留聋人沟通中手势到文本转换之外的情感和体验维度。
一种去中心化的手语解释系统，适应用户的个人手势风格，而非强制用户符合标准化的手势词汇。
一种反思性AI审计框架，持续监控手语模型中的技术标准化偏差，并在系统对自然手语模式施加规范性约束时发出警报。

title: Intern-Atlas: A Methodological Evolution Graph as Research Infrastructure for AI Scientists
summary: Existing research infrastructure is fundamentally document-centric, providing citation links between papers but lacking explicit representations of methodological evolution. In particular, it does not capture the structured relationships that explain how and why research methods emerge, adapt, and build upon one another. With the rise of AI-driven research agents as a new class of consumers of scientific knowledge, this limitation becomes increasingly consequential, as such agents cannot reliably reconstruct method evolution topologies from unstructured text. We introduce Intern-Atlas, a methodological evolution graph that automatically identifies method-level entities, infers lineage relationships among methodologies, and captures the bottlenecks that drive transitions between successive innovations. Built from 1,030,314 papers spanning AI conferences, journals, and arXiv preprints, the resulting graph comprises 9,410,201 semantically typed edges, each grounded in verbatim source evidence, forming a queryable causal network of methodological development. To operationalize this structure, we further propose a self-guided temporal tree search algorithm for constructing evolution chains that trace the progression of methods over time. We evaluate the quality of the resulting graph against expert-curated ground-truth evolution chains and observe strong alignment. In addition, we demonstrate that Intern-Atlas enables downstream applications in idea evaluation and automated idea generation. We position methodological evolution graphs as a foundational data layer for the emerging automated scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Intern-Atlas，一个自动构建的方法演化图谱，从100万+AI论文中提取方法级实体和沿袭关系，形成包含940万个语义类型边的可查询因果网络，并设计自引导时序树搜索算法生成演化链，支撑自动化科学发现。
AI.motivation: 现有研究基础设施以文档为中心，仅提供引用链接，缺乏方法演化的结构化表示，无法捕捉方法如何涌现、适应和继承的因果关系。随着AI研究代理成为科学知识的新消费者，这一限制愈发严重，因为代理无法从非结构化文本中可靠重构方法演化拓扑。
AI.method: 1) 自动识别方法级实体；2) 推断方法间的沿袭关系；3) 捕捉驱动创新更迭的瓶颈；4) 构建包含语义类型边的因果网络；5) 提出自引导时序树搜索算法，用于生成方法演化的时序链。
AI.result: 基于1,030,314篇论文构建的图谱包含9,410,201条语义类型边，每条边均附有原始证据。与专家标注的真实演化链对比，图谱质量高度对齐。在思路评估和自动思路生成等下游任务中表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 方法演化图谱可作为自动化科学发现的基础数据层，解决现有文档中心基础设施的结构化缺失问题，特别适用于AI驱动的知识消费和推理场景。
idea_en: Patent Idea 1: A self-guided temporal tree search algorithm for automatically constructing method evolution chains from a large-scale methodological evolution graph, enabling chronological tracing of how research methods progress over time.

Patent Idea 2: A system for automatic identification of method-level entities and lineage relationships from scientific literature, with each edge grounded in verbatim source evidence, forming a queryable causal network of methodological development.

Patent Idea 3: A method for capturing innovation bottlenecks that drive transitions between successive research methodologies, using semantic typing of evolution edges to identify causal drivers of methodological change.
idea_ch: 专利思路1：自引导时序树搜索算法，从大规模方法演化图谱中自动构建方法演化链，实现研究方法随时间推进的时序追踪。

title: LLM as Clinical Graph Structure Refiner: Enhancing Representation Learning in EEG Seizure Diagnosis
comment: This paper is accepted by the 35th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI-ECAI 2026)
summary: Electroencephalogram (EEG) signals are vital for automated seizure detection, but their inherent noise makes robust representation learning challenging. Existing graph construction methods, whether correlation-based or learning-based, often generate redundant or irrelevant edges due to the noisy nature of EEG data. This significantly impairs the quality of graph representation and limits downstream task performance. Motivated by the remarkable reasoning and contextual understanding capabilities of large language models (LLMs), we explore the idea of using LLMs as graph edge refiners. Specifically, we propose a two-stage framework: we first verify that LLM-based edge refinement can effectively identify and remove redundant connections, leading to significant improvements in seizure detection accuracy and more meaningful graph structures. Building on this insight, we further develop a robust solution where the initial graph is constructed using a Transformer-based edge predictor and multilayer perceptron, assigning probability scores to potential edges and applying a threshold to determine their existence. The LLM then acts as an edge set refiner, making informed decisions based on both textual and statistical features of node pairs to validate the remaining connections. Extensive experiments on TUSZ dataset demonstrate that our LLM-refined graph learning framework not only enhances task performance but also yields cleaner and more interpretable graph representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用大语言模型(LLM)作为图边精炼器的两阶段框架，用于脑电图(EEG)癫痫发作检测。首先验证LLM能有效去除冗余连接，然后构建鲁棒方案：基于Transformer的边缘预测器和MLP构建初始图，再由LLM根据节点对的文本和统计特征验证剩余连接，最终在TUSZ数据集上取得更优性能。
AI.motivation: EEG信号本身噪声大，现有图构建方法（基于相关或基于学习）容易生成冗余或无关边，严重影响图表示质量和下游任务性能。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：(1) 先用Transformer边缘预测器和MLP构建初始图，为潜在边分配概率分数并通过阈值确定边是否存在；(2) LLM作为边缘集精炼器，基于节点对的文本特征和统计特征做出智能决策，验证剩余连接的合理性。
AI.result: 在TUSZ数据集上的实验表明，LLM精炼的图学习框架不仅提升了任务性能，还生成了更清晰、更可解释的图表示。
AI.conclusion: LLM可以作为有效的图边缘精炼器，通过结合语义理解和统计特征来优化EEG信号图结构，从而提高癫痫检测的准确性和图的可解释性。
idea_en: A two-stage graph construction framework for EEG signal processing, where a Transformer-based edge predictor and MLP generate initial probability scores for potential graph edges, followed by an LLM-based edge refiner that validates remaining connections using both textual and statistical features of node pairs.

A method for using Large Language Models (LLMs) as graph edge refiners in EEG-based seizure detection systems, where the LLM makes informed decisions to identify and remove redundant or irrelevant connections between graph nodes.

A graph representation learning approach for noisy EEG signals that combines statistical edge probability scoring with LLM-driven contextual reasoning to produce cleaner and more interpretable graph structures.
A system that extracts both textual features and statistical features from EEG node pairs and feeds them into an LLM for edge validation in seizure detection tasks.

title: Synthetic Computers at Scale for Long-Horizon Productivity Simulation
summary:
Realistic long-horizon productivity work is strongly conditioned on user-specific computer environments, where much of the work context is stored and organized through directory structures and content-rich artifacts. To scale synthetic data creation for such productivity scenarios, we introduce Synthetic Computers at Scale, a scalable methodology for creating such environments with realistic folder hierarchies and content-rich artifacts (e.g., documents, spreadsheets, and presentations). Conditioned on each synthetic computer, we run long-horizon simulations: one agent creates productivity objectives that are specific to the computer's user and require multiple professional deliverables and about a month of human work; another agent then acts as that user and keeps working across the computer -- for example, navigating the filesystem for grounding, coordinating with simulated collaborators, and producing professional artifacts -- until these objectives are completed.
  In preliminary experiments, we create 1,000 synthetic computers and run long-horizon simulations on them; each run requires over 8 hours of agent runtime and spans more than 2,000 turns on average. These simulations produce rich experiential learning signals, whose effectiveness is validated by significant improvements in agent performance on both in-domain and out-of-domain productivity evaluations. Given that personas are abundant at billion scale, this methodology can in principle scale to millions or even billions of synthetic user worlds with sufficient compute, enabling broader coverage of diverse professions, roles, contexts, environments, and productivity needs. We argue that scalable synthetic computer creation, together with at-scale simulations, is highly promising as a foundational substrate for agent self-improvement and agentic reinforcement learning in long-horizon productivity scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可扩展的合成计算机生成方法，用于创建具有真实文件夹层次和丰富内容的用户环境，并通过长时间代理模拟生成经验学习信号，从而提升代理在长周期生产力任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现实中的长周期生产力任务高度依赖用户特定的计算机环境（如目录结构、文档、表格等），而传统数据生成方法难以大规模创建此类真实环境，限制了代理在复杂生产力场景中的自我提升和强化学习。
AI.method: 1. 规模化合成计算机创建：生成包含真实文件夹层次和内容丰富的工件（如文档、表格、演示文稿）的用户环境。2. 长周期模拟：一个代理创建特定于该计算机用户的生产力目标（需多份专业交付物、约一个月工作量）；另一代理作为用户在该计算机上持续工作（如导航文件系统、与模拟协作者协调、制作专业工件）直至目标完成。
AI.result: 初步实验中创建了1000个合成计算机并运行长周期模拟，每次运行需超8小时代理运行时间，平均超2000轮次。这些模拟产生丰富的经验学习信号，显著提升了代理在域内和域外生产力评估中的表现。
AI.conclusion: 身份数据可达数十亿规模，该方法理论上可扩展至数百万甚至数十亿合成用户世界，覆盖多样化职业、角色、环境和生产力需求。规模化合成计算机创建结合大规模模拟，是长周期生产力场景中代理自我提升和强化学习的理想基础。
idea_en: A scalable method for automatically generating synthetic computer environments with realistic folder hierarchies and content-rich artifacts (documents, spreadsheets, presentations) for agent training.

A dual-agent simulation framework where one agent generates user-specific long-horizon productivity objectives and another agent acts as the user to complete them within the synthetic computer environment.
A methodology for generating experiential learning signals from long-horizon agent simulations (8+ hours, 2000+ turns per run) that improve agent performance on productivity tasks.
A system for creating synthetic user worlds at scale (theoretically billions) with diverse professional roles, contexts, and environments for agent reinforcement learning.
idea_ch: 一种自动生成合成计算机环境的方法，可创建逼真的文件夹层次结构和内容丰富的工件（文档、表格、演示文稿），用于代理训练。
一种双代理模拟框架：一个代理生成用户特定的长周期生产力目标，另一个代理作为用户在合成计算机环境中完成这些目标。
一种从长周期代理模拟（每次运行8小时以上、2000多轮次）中生成经验学习信号的方法，可提升代理在生产力任务上的表现。
一种大规模创建合成用户世界（理论上可达数十亿）的系统，覆盖多样化职业、角色、环境和生产力需求，用于代理强化学习。
